subject: Onward to the General Election!
body:
Last Tuesday was a monumental day for all of us as we stood together to make our voices heard in the California primary election. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/davidkimforca/onward-to-the-general-election?e=fee98d637f)
---
| |
---
| | Dear Friends,

I hope this email finds you well and filled with the same hope and determination that has driven our campaign thus far. Last Tuesday was a monumental day for all of us as we stood together to make our voices heard in the California primary election.

I am deeply grateful to each and every one of you who turned out to vote, who volunteered, who donated generously, and who spread our message of hope and progress across every corner of our district. Your unwavering support has been the fuel that propelled us forward, and I am humbled by the trust you have placed in me to be your voice.

While the final results are still being tallied, it is becoming increasingly clear that we are poised for a rematch in the general election against the incumbent, Jimmy Gomez. This is an opportunity for us to continue the fight for real change in our community, to amplify our voices, and to champion the values we hold dear.

As we look ahead to the general election, I want to emphasize that our work is far from over. In fact, it has only just begun. True progressivism requires dedication, perseverance, and a steadfast commitment to justice and equality for all. I cannot do this alone; I need each and every one of you by my side as we embark on the next phase of this journey.

Together, we have the power to shape the future of our district and our state. Together, we can build a brighter, more equitable future for every working family in CA-34 and around the country. But it will take all of us, united in purpose and driven by our shared values, to make that vision a reality.

So let us recommit ourselves to the task at hand, let us redouble our efforts, and let us continue to stand together as we march towards victory in November. I am proud to have you on this journey with me, and I am confident that, together, we will prevail.

Thank you once again for your incredible support, your unwavering dedication, and your steadfast belief in our cause. Let's get to work!

In solidarity,
David Kim

At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c31617%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=dh2ZRXZUD0PnCT9XgNydlQ&sysid=1)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c31617%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=dh2ZRXZUD0PnCT9XgNydlQ&sysid=1)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. name: Riley Gaines
subject: Don’t let them ignore my assault
body:
The news just broke that the investigation into my case was suspended

| Fellow Conservative, At San Francisco State University last April, I was physically assaulted by an angry mob, barricaded in a classroom, and held for ransom for four hours. I’m still waiting for justice. **The news just broke that the investigation into my case was suspended by the San Francisco State University police - with no charges filed. The officer who replied to my inquiry said, “The charges in this case are unfounded.”** This just encourages what happened to me to happen to more people who dare to question common sense, lived experience, and reality. We don’t see this happen to so-called “progressive” speakers, or to anyone who dissents from my viewpoint. While I was locked in the classroom that would become my prison for hours, I wrote on social media, **“When they want you silent, speak louder.”** I am more determined than ever to keep speaking louder. [That’s exactly what my team and I do here at the Leadership Institute.](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c31614%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=%2be2Jgj3A1%2bYwujU33EjTGA&sysid=1)__ Through the **Riley Gaines Center** at the Leadership Institute, my team of Ambassadors and I spearhead a growing nationwide movement to defend women, common sense, and free speech. We travel the country to spread the word on more college campuses. We encourage more girls and women to share their stories and protect themselves against radical gender ideology. We defend basic biological reality - and the very concept of truth itself. Women fought for equality. Now our achievements are erased by men who merely declare themselves women. This social contagion robs women of opportunities, puts them in physical danger, and silences them when they dare to dissent.
That’s why my colleagues and I show college-aged students how to speak out bravely. We connect them with Leadership Institute training opportunities where they develop their skills. Armed with LI training, these young people become principled leaders on their campuses and in their communities - and fight for America’s future. [I’d love to have you join this movement to defend women, sanity, and free speech.](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c31625%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=qRV5TwhkPD9mq5ttW83SNg&sysid=1)**** Stand bravely with me, Riley Gaines

at the Leadership Institute

name: Caleb Max
subject: Reminder: Times Up TikTok - Fighting Back to Save the Next Generation of Americans
body:
We Need Your Support Today
| | | |
---
| Join Me Today in Stopping the CCP!
---
| Dear Peter,
I am back in the fight against Communist China. We were extremely successful in eliminating the Chinese Communist Party's Confucius Institutes from our college campuses. Now we must tackle another, even bigger issue that is impacting every American family.
It is time for the United States to take back the minds of its youth. Minds that have been poisoned by the Communist Party of China via its propaganda machine; TikTok.
President Xi Jinping himself stated: "Many people, especially young people, do not read mainstream media and get most of their information from the internet. We must face up to this fact, increase investment, and seize the initiative on this battlefield of public opinion as soon as possible." The initiative the Chinese Party funded is TikTok.
Yintao Yu, former head of US engineering for ByteDance (parent company of TikTok), in a legal filing and testimony last year stated that TikTok "enabled a special committee of Chinese Communist Party members stationed at the company to view all data collected by ByteDance/TikTok including those of U.S. users....and it was recently used to keep tabs on Hong Kong protesters and civil rights activists by monitoring their locations and devices, their network information, SIM card identifications, IP addresses and communications."
This week, thanks to the courage and bipartisanship of Chairman Mike Gallagher and Congressman Raja Krishnamoorthi there is now a bill being moved in Congress that would force TikTok to either sell to an American company, or face closure in the U.S. and its territories. The bill has already passed the Energy and Commerce Committee in a UNANIMOUS vote, and Joe Biden's administration has endorsed it.
However, the work is far from complete. TikTok has one of the strongest lobbying armies in Washington, DC. According to Chairman Gallagher: "TikTok is digital fentanyl, addicting our kids, and just like actual fentanyl, it ultimately goes back to the Chinese Communist Party. ... Oh, and oh, by the way, TikTok is using the swamp against us. | **** We have watched atrocities inflicted on Americans in real time because of the current administration's open-border policy. There is **_no_** excuse, only the realization that the Biden Administration wants to destroy America through policy and intimidation.Never forget, **_you_** as a citizen have the right to make your voice heard - no matter what side of the fence your elected officials sit on.This week we are splitting the call to action up by which chamber you will be contacting, and then at the end, be sure to read about how you can make long-term changes to save our country.

** The House impeached Alejandro Mayorkas for his dereliction of duty regarding our border. The United States Senate is responsible for hosting impeachment trial. However, the Democrat majority in the Senate is making it difficult to push those proceedings forward - in fact, Democrats are likely to vote to dismiss the impeachment instead of holding the trial.
Additionally, the Senate needs to take up and pass H.R. 2, the Border Security Act already passed by the House. It is a real security bill that our country desperately needs now.
When you call your Senators, give them **two messages:**
1. The U.S. Senate must hold the Maryorkas impeachment trial. Every senator is obligated to hear the evidence. To vote to dismiss rather than hold the trial would be a grave injustice to the American people, motivated by partisanship, rather than what's best for our country.
2. We need border security now. H.R. 2 already passed the House and the Senate must take it up and pass it as soon as possible. The murder of Laken Riley in Georgia yet again demonstrates the urgent need to secure our border and stop illegal immigration.

Call your senators, even if they are Democrats. name: Hillsdale College via Freedom Liberty Report
subject: Justice, weaponized
body:
Please particpate in this survey on the Department of Justice.

This sponsored message from Freedom Liberty Report is on behalf of Hillsdale College

[](http://email.alert.freedomandlibertyreport.com/c/eJyUkc-OnDAMh58m3EDGcYE9cBiJ5TS7rbqHHlGGGCar_FMSWs3bV7TTB-jVP_mzP_vH2_KmjDV-f1eOx82mJeXFq-VurK2zskdRxQRf5yMtCEg1yLqVi6z0CO2LJqp4bPsWJCLKvrqP3BEhyZ6o42EA5LUDII0rKrxtG1ZmPDkgWwk9dZKaAbqX4UsHA_Wq1zcWBMpyKs2WmHVwymtrbpzKI3EMqTRrcJUd76XELORF4CxwtrE5V85aWW5YHwJnzVGl4tiXOmz155GLWfkU-cmPs0nOeRVyghYI3gEJr3CZvk6vrx8Cu6O4JYcjrSzkFFPIkddi_P6MHGtzOCEndsrYZ3FVLiqzeyEnHT7_DfobBV_YFyGnj8t1-Xap5-v3-nkHrNKo4y9jrcldLwj2k_nHsvzHR34HAAD___Xuk-s) Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email—I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty—including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://email.alert.freedomandlibertyreport.com/c/eJyUkc-OnDAMh58m3EDGcYE9cBiJ5TS7rbqHHlGGGCar_FMSWs3bV7TTB-jVP_mzP_vH2_KmjDV-f1eOx82mJeXFq-VurK2zskdRxQRf5yMtCEg1yLqVi6z0CO2LJqp4bPsWJCLKvrqP3BEhyZ6o42EA5LUDII0rKrxtG1ZmPDkgWwk9dZKaAbqX4UsHA_Wq1zcWBMpyKs2WmHVwymtrbpzKI3EMqTRrcJUd76XELORF4CxwtrE5V85aWW5YHwJnzVGl4tiXOmz155GLWfkU-cmPs0nOeRVyghYI3gEJr3CZvk6vrx8Cu6O4JYcjrSzkFFPIkddi_P6MHGtzOCEndsrYZ3FVLiqzeyEnHT7_DfobBV_YFyGnj8t1-Xap5-v3-nkHrNKo4y9jrcldLwj2k_nHsvzHR34HAAD___Xuk-s)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights—to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more—are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight—in which Hillsdale College is a leader—is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** —on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.—who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://email.alert.freedomandlibertyreport.com/c/eJyUkc-OnDAMh58m3EDGcYE9cBiJ5TS7rbqHHlGGGCar_FMSWs3bV7TTB-jVP_mzP_vH2_KmjDV-f1eOx82mJeXFq-VurK2zskdRxQRf5yMtCEg1yLqVi6z0CO2LJqp4bPsWJCLKvrqP3BEhyZ6o42EA5LUDII0rKrxtG1ZmPDkgWwk9dZKaAbqX4UsHA_Wq1zcWBMpyKs2WmHVwymtrbpzKI3EMqTRrcJUd76XELORF4CxwtrE5V85aWW5YHwJnzVGl4tiXOmz155GLWfkU-cmPs0nOeRVyghYI3gEJr3CZvk6vrx8Cu6O4JYcjrSzkFFPIkddi_P6MHGtzOCEndsrYZ3FVLiqzeyEnHT7_DfobBV_YFyGnj8t1-Xap5-v3-nkHrNKo4y9jrcldLwj2k_nHsvzHR34HAAD___Xuk-s)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

| "When Maria Montero was growing up in small-town Pennsylvania, she used to sit with her grandfather and watch him shout at Ronald Reagan on the television. Most people in her neighbourhood, Hispanics who had moved out into steel and coal country to find work and cheap housing, were true-blue Democrats.
But as she listened, Reagan and his message of hard work and the American dream struck a chord. Now she is running for Congress as a Republican. And increasingly, it is President Biden who is drawing the ire of Hispanics in a realignment that could win Donald Trump the election.
"Over the last 15 years I've seen my friends who were registered Democrats become Republican, not because they've changed, but because they feel that the Democrat party has changed," said Montero, 47, an American lawyer of Peruvian, Irish, and Italian descent with a sheet of long black hair. "They just feel like the values of the Democratic Party are not focusing on America's best interests, like making sure we have a secure border, making sure we're supporting our law enforcement."
Hispanics are the fastest-growing voter demographic in the United States. They make up nearly 15 per cent of the electorate, registering to vote in record numbers -- a quiet wave breaking across the country, from Texas and Arizona to Pennsylvania, Michigan and Wisconsin. This November, for the first time, they will outnumber black voters, whose support has underpinned every Democratic president since the civil rights reforms of the 1960s.
They are some of the most powerful voters, and a rising number are turning towards Trump. In 2020 Biden won Hispanic voters by 21 percentage points but last month a poll by The New York Times predicted that Trump would win the Latino vote with 46 per cent to Biden's 40 per cent (though this almost exclusively polled English-speakers, leaving out the mainly low-income Spanish-speakers who would tend to vote Democrat).
In a poll conducted by the Latino Public Opinion Forum late last year, 58 per cent of Hispanic voters said the Democratic Party best represented their values, but nearly 20 per cent said they had considered switching parties in the past year. Of those, 38 percent said that the switch was from Democrat to Republican, 23 percent from Democrat to independent, and only 11 per cent from Republican to Democrat and 9 per cent from independent to Democrat.
"It's a clear trend, and it's a clear trend all over," said Eduardo Gamarra, a professor of politics at Florida International University, who directed the poll. "There are more Hispanics who are becoming Republicans, and there are also more Hispanics who are becoming independents."

Now, the real fight begins. I'm ready to outwork, outraise, and out-organize Ted Cruz to win this thing, and with multiple polls already showing me TIED with Ted, I'm confident we can do it. But I also know Cruz is backed by wealthy mega donors who will spend whatever it takes to keep him in office. That’s why I need you with me: Please, will you chip in $10 – or whatever you can spare – to help reach my $1 million General Election Kickoff goal? [Every dollar you can spare will power our people-powered movement through Election Day so we can defeat Ted Cruz and deliver better, stronger leadership for the people of Texas. Will you help kick our campaign off in a huge way by donating $10 or more to me and Blue Amp Action right now? ](https://default.salsalabs.org/T45e6925b-0779-473f-8b55-a7133c6542b1/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| | | I’m a fourth generation Texan, born and raised in Dallas by a single mom. My mom was a public school teacher and sometimes worked two jobs to make ends meet. Thanks to my family and a strong support system of teachers, coaches, and the good folks at the YMCA, I earned a full-ride football scholarship to Baylor University and then went on to play in the NFL. But playing football was never my only dream – from a young age I knew I wanted to help people. So I became a civil rights attorney to defend what I believe is our most fundamental right: the right to vote. I proudly served in President Obama’s administration before I came home to Dallas, where my wife, Aly, and I are now raising our family. I ran for Congress in 2018 because I wanted more kids in North Texas to have the opportunity to achieve their version of the American dream. I also saw that our democracy was in peril and wanted to be part of protecting it. No one gave me a chance in that race, but I beat the odds to defeat an 11-term Republican incumbent. Since then, I'm proud to have been named the most bipartisan member of the Texas delegation. Now, I’m ready for my next challenge: firing Ted Cruz and being the voice all Texans need in the Senate. We're already better off than we were in 2018, with experts calling Cruz the most vulnerable GOP Senator in the country, and two polls in a row showing us tied. I'm not saying it will be easy, but with you on my grassroots team, I know we can get it done, Peter. [That’s why I’m asking you to chip in right now to become a General Election Founding Donor and help reach our ambitious $1 million goal. We need an unprecedented grassroots movement to unseat Ted Cruz, and I’m counting on you to be a part of it. Please, rush $10, or whatever you can spare, to help me and Blue Amp Action win in Texas, defeat Ted Cruz, and give Texans the leadership we deserve. →](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tde7c11e2-d356-4109-8e22-8be9c680c544/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Thank you so much for being a part of my team. Your support has gotten me this far, and it's why I know we can win. Let's do this, Colin Allred

Over the past decade it has infected democratic societies--including ours. It is as simple as it is terrifying: What we do now will define the future of our country and world. We at Blue Amp Action are dedicated to liberal, open societies, where reason and science are applied to solve our problems; where civil rights--including voting rights!--are protected for all. We fight for these values every day. Speaking up on our platforms, raising the voices and the political prospects of liberal pols and pundits. **And savvy grassroots activists like you know, just like we do, that we can’t stop watching the people we help elect:_ after the elections, we have to keep organizing support for the policies we like and pushing back against the ones we don’t._** **__When the public tunes out between elections and the only people our elected officials hear from are the paid lobbyists of wealthy corporations, our government stops being accountable to the needs of ordinary families.__** **Democracy never sleeps, and neither can we.** So we ask that you support our work, so we can continue to engage in this fight every moment of every day. name: Hillsdale College via Restore Our Nation
subject: Survey on the Department of Justice
body:
Please particpate in this survey on the Department of Justice.

This sponsored message from Restore Our Nation is on behalf of Hillsdale College

[](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/VkD1jAUSVuDiyow7ft7xMA~~/AARclAA~~~) Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email—I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty—including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/VkD1jAUSVuDiyow7ft7xMA~~/AARclAA~~~)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights—to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more—are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight—in which Hillsdale College is a leader—is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** —on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.—who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/VkD1jAUSVuDiyow7ft7xMA~~/AARclAA~~~)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

name: Riley Gaines
subject: When they want you silent, speak louder
body:
The news just broke that the investigation into my case was suspended

| Fellow Conservative, At San Francisco State University last April, I was physically assaulted by an angry mob, barricaded in a classroom, and held for ransom for four hours. I'm still waiting for justice. **The news just broke that the investigation into my case was suspended by the San Francisco State University police - with no charges filed. The officer who replied to my inquiry said, "The charges in this case are unfounded."** This just encourages what happened to me to happen to more people who dare to question common sense, lived experience, and reality. We don't see this happen to so-called "progressive" speakers, or to anyone who dissents from my viewpoint. While I was locked in the classroom that would become my prison for hours, I wrote on social media, **" When they want you silent, speak louder."** I am more determined than ever to keep speaking louder. [That's exactly what my team and I do here at the Leadership Institute.](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=18e4ae34da7149379e99e2dbce70700f&_e=3WjfbWDDxkFMjtO4nC7UGXAtE8GckxpbJ5qW-yBDQGBijd89KMqe_E-n3VRSN0_tdPTzgWZUW4Glw7tvw5iV4BNMn8QrEl7GLj_GiFY9F0OZu90HhuUzUTX3i3c75ec6oONadr8ws3At0qsLytQOLbyNFP2XAQ3IWYGGS1D5vFRncEAvUHhuBxATsUddJnq0nAq6eGq1YOl5gXeMebmxQiur2HesHurMmVPnuhj9lGQ%3D)__ Through the **Riley Gaines Center** at the Leadership Institute, my team of Ambassadors and I spearhead a growing nationwide movement to defend women, common sense, and free speech. We travel the country to spread the word on more college campuses. We encourage more girls and women to share their stories and protect themselves against radical gender ideology. We defend basic biological reality - and the very concept of truth itself. Women fought for equality. Now our achievements are erased by men who merely declare themselves women. This social contagion robs women of opportunities, puts them in physical danger, and silences them when they dare to dissent.
That's why my colleagues and I show college-aged students how to speak out bravely. We connect them with Leadership Institute training opportunities where they develop their skills. Armed with LI training, these young people become principled leaders on their campuses and in their communities - and fight for America's future. ## Trump, Biden Clinch Nominations
Former President Donald Trump and President Biden grabbed enough delegates in yesterday's state primaries [to clinch their parties' nominations](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGOqzAQheGngY7I9pgBChe3SZfbbokGexxmZWwETqK8_Spbb3l0mk__122-kSTJ9_-0sauxzOSrPHmGTkNn7Gzb4CKzYWjZ6UErAJwQ2tVFGpmHMC7QLxOMkYKBkZcJpgE89qoVZ5SxCjRopXqLF62XEIAJzYCMdmis4iC1HJfvIrmuHNO7PPm4-LK1ya217mcD_xpzbcyV9syv83N9xlHFJ27MtR6Pbe8CJ75T5bM7eH8sSTzlLpdNMlUpuVsp8bvThgEwMC-oJ1QmjgB91N560ojA7eHC_pKU5MQP7r6RpF9M_TPNTwAAAP__Yetksg). Trump began the day with 1,078 delegates and ended it with 1,241--more than enough to [make his victory official](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL1uhDAQhJ_GdEb-O5MrXKShu7Qp0YIX2MjGlu07dG8fkTrSFCNNMZ--78f0AAp0bF8Q0bU1TbA0euGkudRcmcl03q2ICnWHTg5SaG3vVne7M6s0_ibUzcpZrx8wS7yLRQzgUYAYfEdOCWWElloKcTO2l3L2XiNYNVi0ZmBGoKeWSv-T6Gg7ruGdXlj6JcUuuL21XJn-ZGpkajzPs1_meuBZr52p8apMjRumshHwSLVeyZk4BJghAs-FIpQ3L1ifoVU-k8eDt_KMmamxK87nk0Kgai-YLQKFv_P2r4rfAAAA__-Xf2Hm). At the GOP national convention in July, he'll become the first Republican in history to secure the presidential nomination three straight times. Biden secured his nomination with his win in Mississippi, putting him over the needed 1,968 delegate count. The two victories mark one of the [earliest starts](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L1u8yAUxvGrwRsWcAiOBw-v9Mpbqm4dLT4O9okwWJgmyt1X6dz5GZ6f_l-35WYpUV4_7I5Ti2WxvtEDF-ASuNKL7sIUERVCh5McpAAwo4Fum4J0EfwQRwvDCGO4xot1KKIGdNY57GhSQmkBEqQQF216KV0IgNaowaDRA9MCA7VS-3uh3DaM6VUeWHtf9i5NW2vHyeAfUzNTs3U-4_Ps1_KemZo_S6JG_mRqdhQw86OWO_qGgftE2W_8fc9z2SnbRiXzVr_3gz-wrsjUfLZSXwxmCgz-S3EV0oAeuzqF40kp0WnewHW3lH5B7c88PwEAAP__oUFm0A) of the presidential general election in modern history. The [latest polling shows](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFuMyEQBOCnge5OsIvBLij-hs5_m_KEzZ5NwsEJiE9--4jUqWZWmuLTflyXq48p5sd_v5Hta1n8vccXLThJnEAtige7EgEhJyuNFIj6opE_LV6Mvp2MkSoYj17JszkbCcbQZRWSVh4tCFACJUohTkrPUt5CQPIajCatDFOCQuylzp8l5v6kNb3Li-p8LxtP9tn73hj-Y-AYuOM45ko-3RP5upc00GPIwI2rjazUYqDcGbgHZao-MXADwcD1-r3t06tNtzEZ5YtypvAe9aDWR7ZOMfNqw37ElGLTw_jYfEy_pv7nh34CAAD__60VaEo) former President Trump in a three-point lead over Biden, on average, and a large lead over independent RFK Jr.
## Boeing Woes Spread to Airlines
With millions of spring break vacationers preparing for air travel, airplane manufacturer Boeing and several airlines it serves find themselves facing [several crises](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0DGP4yAUBOBfgzss4BFQCopr3OXaKy0Mj_idMEQGx5f79StvvfWMRp_mz2N-eMpUnr_9hq6nOvvQ6Y0zcAlc6VkP0SVEhTCgk1YKAHM3MKxOmADa3paYMNx9THebwg2TXFQSYDEN5JRQWoAEKcRNm1HKJUZAb5Q1aLRlWmCkXvfxb6XSV0z5U9-4j6FuQ3Zr76_G4BdTE1PTeZ5jKEu4Qqama5qpSQBTk1RMTcl77o9IndfEl4pUno1bsHzz__hrr_EInWrhqR4l8lj_Y2lXlVo7sPHy6ePatzzsLr5OypmauYDPzVP-BvUf7_kKAAD__6ZiZpU). Southwest and United have both [paused hiring new pilots](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGOtCAURp8GOwxwETMFxd_Yzd9uaRCuencRJoBj9u03br31yffl5Hw856ejSGn77w60bc2z843eOAOXwJWedRfsiqgQOrRylALAPAx0u13QGD16MwgPYRiFHKTT8BjBaPlwfujIKqG0AAlSiEGbXsolBEBn1GjQ6JFpgYFaLv1nptR2XON3fmPpfT66aPfWXpXBP6YmpqbrunqfFn9Dpqb7mqlJAFOTVExNNZ9tv7A27qhESlh5QXy7eLpGaeP3gG8nBZc88gW9OyvyvPIl481fJS8Rj8rr7gpWXil99Xs7YldseF0UI1VzK2-Ho_ir2P4M9hMAAP__0SBsJA), and Southwest will reconfigure its capacity and number of flights due to Boeing's inability to deliver new planes on time. Last week, passengers on the Boeing 737 Max 9 jet flown by Alaska Airlines that had a door fly off the aircraft filed a [$1 billion lawsuit.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFutDAQhJ_GdEZ4bXw_hYu_obu0KdGC17CJD5-wOStvHxEpXbqRZkb69L3fpzty5H19wwe5EtKES-EXTVoqLcFMpvEuEAHphpy6qU5rO1jdbA570DYE39vQo6EBYMCAuARaln7AuWEHHZhOK626rje2VWr2XhNauFmy5iZMR55LOtqPxHvZKMSv9KKjXdKjiW4r5ZmF_i9gFDDWWttlzjvVfPUCxisKGDFi_kSJfETeKcsQed2KVPAPpE_pkM94rnKOqaazSCVnjpHTLiPWfHL5Pco5Ee-rgLE5nH_Wa5Xtxbg-kOMPU_nT0HcAAAD__20Yaik) The DOJ has since opened a [criminal investigation](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFu8yAURp8GNiy4EPx7YPgXb-na0SJwsW-KITIkVt--Sudun_QN5-h8Xperp0xl_fA7up7q4kOnFy5aKC3ALIZHlxABNUenRiW1tpPVfHMXkP8spqhwTJMOYC9yDCGFEH2YlJo4OZBgpFZaSXkxdlDqFqNGb2G0aM3IjMRIvR7DvVLpG6b8XV94DKHuPLut90dj-j-DmcF8nufw1cr7YzAXPBuD-fZsVLC9Z99QxHoX2T9L2LCJcNBOxWdB5YWt0-o71SKo9CpuFamsDGZ-uPg4KWdq9u2z7p7yL7__WeMnAAD__8o-Yrs) into the incident. United had a variety of incidents last week, with planes being forced to reroute due to airplane problems. Travelers at the Jacksonville International Airport [expressed concern ](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDGPszAMQH9N2IKIk4avA8O3sPXWG5EJprgXEpTkSvvvT7n5FkuWnvT8_Hmbbsiew_0DdxrKGid0hZ80aam0BDOZZhlWIiDd0KB61Wltr1Y32wAEF4erImcW2zutrrPTV2uxV-vaq7nhATownVZadd3F2FapeVk0oYXekjW9MB0tXGJqH5FD2Wj17_ik1Lq4N37YSjmy0P8FjALG8zzbQGc2D3xVQMBYVwGjjw69gLHaBIydruOfgDEficNdzonwS5aET_KUsswbJpI7v2iRiWpvDFniHL-LRE6eA8mMK5W3xJ0r4ygUuXPe8KjCJg3LcbL3nG2NuO_I_vfo8ucLfwIAAP__GO1zsw)about the recent aircraft failures, especially a Boeing 777 that lost a wheel shortly after takeoff. Yesterday, a longtime Boeing employee-turned-whistleblower against the company [was found dead](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxszztuxCAUheHVQIcFXIzjgiKNu0mb0uJxbRhhGNloUHYfOXW6I53i0__9WB825VT2L3ugaVtdrW_pjSswAUyqVdFgNkSJQNGISXAAPWug0Qgegp_B-dGCEuM2-Q-hRiXD7DbHLdBkJJeKgwDB-aj0IIQLAdBqOWnUaiKKY0itnsOzptIibvmnvvEcfD1oNrG110Xgk8iFyKX3Pnh3FezX_RO53JPI5VljYc6eBVtjrmIqO-sxXS2jy7XjyQLaFolc6GnCq6ec06VvfD9syn9Y-zf9NwAA__90sluO). A police report stated that he died of a self-inflicted gunshot wound.
## List: Home Prices in Every U.S. County
A new database lists the [median prices for homes in 3,000 counties](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFygzAQRL9GdGKkO1mCQkUadU6bkpHhMJcA8iDZhL_P4DrVFrsz--Z9Xbtr5JnX-2dcyJcxdbEv_KIOpUYJpjPV4EciIKzIa6cVom0tVpPHm3ambS_gHPVNjKrXRC02asQxusZU7EGBUahRK3Uxttb6NgxI0YKzZI0TRtHAJW31d-K1TDTOR3rRVvdpqWY_lfLIAj8EBAFh3_f6mWNJQzzOgYCQS9oOAWFJK5153gkICgUEDe8iF0m_D1ozv0hO6Zl5vcslbj9UsuRVxoU27qOA4KBF1WitlBMQqs0Pj53nmbM9Oe9L5PnNVf619BcAAP__c-VmAA) across all 50 states, along with a color-coded map indicating which states have the most expensive housing. The report, compiled by the National Association of Realtors from U.S. Census data, shows that four California counties are among the five most expensive in America, followed by counties in Massachusetts. subject: BREAKING NEWS: Police suspend my assault case
body:
The news just broke that the investigation into my case was suspended

| Fellow Conservative, At San Francisco State University last April, I was physically assaulted by an angry mob, barricaded in a classroom, and held for ransom for four hours. I’m still waiting for justice. **The news just broke that the investigation into my case was suspended by the San Francisco State University police – with no charges filed. The officer who replied to my inquiry said, “The charges in this case are unfounded.”** This just encourages what happened to me to happen to more people who dare to question common sense, lived experience, and reality. We don’t see this happen to so-called “progressive” speakers, or to anyone who dissents from my viewpoint. While I was locked in the classroom that would become my prison for hours, I wrote on social media, **“When they want you silent, speak louder.”** I am more determined than ever to keep speaking louder. [That’s exactly what my team and I do here at the Leadership Institute.](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/s5mz2a9vQCWFdNfITIAB_A~~/AARclAA~/RgRn1Ce6P0QuaHR0cHM6Ly9weGwuaXN0L2FzZnJuNWJmZWs_c291cmNlX2NvZGU9Q0I0NzM5OVcDc3BjQgpl70WE8WVGD2YSUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)__ Through the **Riley Gaines Center** at the Leadership Institute, my team of Ambassadors and I spearhead a growing nationwide movement to defend women, common sense, and free speech. We travel the country to spread the word on more college campuses. We encourage more girls and women to share their stories and protect themselves against radical gender ideology. We defend basic biological reality – and the very concept of truth itself. Women fought for equality. Now our achievements are erased by men who merely declare themselves women. This social contagion robs women of opportunities, puts them in physical danger, and silences them when they dare to dissent.
That’s why my colleagues and I show college-aged students how to speak out bravely. We connect them with Leadership Institute training opportunities where they develop their skills. Armed with LI training, these young people become principled leaders on their campuses and in their communities – and fight for America’s future. [I’d love to have you join this movement to defend women, sanity, and free speech.](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/s5mz2a9vQCWFdNfITIAB_A~~/AARclAA~/RgRn1Ce6P0QuaHR0cHM6Ly9weGwuaXN0L2FzZnJuNWJmZWs_c291cmNlX2NvZGU9Q0I0NzM5OVcDc3BjQgpl70WE8WVGD2YSUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)**** Stand bravely with me, Riley Gaines

subject: Important Clarification on TikTok Legislation Vote
body:
Peter, I wanted to reach out to you today to clarify the purpose and implications of the upcoming vote concerning TikTok and its parent company, ByteDance.
Peter, I wanted to reach out to you today to clarify the purpose and implications of the upcoming vote concerning TikTok and its parent company, ByteDance. With the vote set for this Wednesday, understanding the bill's true intention is crucial amid various discussions and viewpoints.This legislation is not about banning TikTok. Instead, it mandates ByteDance to divest its ownership of TikTok. We aim to **_protect American users' data_** from potential misuse by foreign entities, particularly the Chinese government. This approach focuses on a divestiture that would remove ByteDance's control over TikTok, safeguarding user data without removing the app from American digital platforms. **The bill has received bipartisan backing, highlighting our unified commitment to _national security and privacy protection_. Amidst differing opinions and public discourse, we must base our stance on the legislation's actual goals -- ensuring the safety and security of our national interests.** We appreciate your understanding and support on this critical issue and are here to address any questions or concerns you may have.Warm regards,
Anthony D'Esposito | | [Unsubscribe](https://despositoforcongress.cmail19.com/t/y-u-xhktkll-dytjdljkkt-r/)
---

body:
USA is starting an exciting new outreach program that anyone can participate in, regardless of how busy they might be.
|

Thank you for your support for United Sovereign Americans (USA) and our efforts to bring our elections back into compliance with the law. You have either offered to volunteer (thanks!), made a donation (Thanks!), done volunteer work for us (THANKS!), or just asked to be kept informed about our activities. The only way we can solve this dilemma of elections that are so flawed they are meaningless, is to take action. One of those actions is to share what you know about valid elections with friends, neighbors, and family. 90% of Americans actively use social media accounts, and they are a great way to spread the word about our election concerns. USA is starting an exciting new outreach program that anyone can participate in, regardless of how busy they might be. It’s called the Grassroots Social Media Team (GSMT), and we will be creating short videos that explain why all Americans, regardless of political party, should care about honest and accurate elections. Check out our first three videos [HERE!](https://d56tDQ04.na1.hubspotlinks.com/Ctc/UD+113/d56tDQ04/VVVplp1_wQbSW7NJXg28K8wKtW4lQ0X35bD3lJN2glj0T3m2ndW6N1vHY6lZ3p9N2N5vrkqQpbwW4Lv92B6yYXb3W1m27tQ73Js3BN2vl_vgGrNbkW3F-8nz8dGhpMW2N4tnN1HrjvsW6PPgJ72kYny9W8b5s2T5dcx2PW5T_yfD8F8kdJW5NmJlR2jTD9cW4LK7z-20rhxlW2zYbSs5qlQQrW7dJw966g2_WfW2B8f0q1R7R64W1BPhgd2mFTkXW3h-LDW6TgqF8W2QrDKf42TWmrVC838Z1t6vYhW7XHLq01WywL-N9gcBWJ4kGf8W3MFFMJ5jDKWpW2w4v6p5yGxz6f9386FR04) It will take just a few minutes of your time, 1-3 times a week. You can sign up to join our special GSMT email list [HERE](https://d56tDQ04.na1.hubspotlinks.com/Ctc/UD+113/d56tDQ04/VVVplp1_wQbSW7NJXg28K8wKtW4lQ0X35bD3lJN2glj183m2ndW7lCdLW6lZ3lnN4FKLkmFB8ZQW1wbVgc1HZpbJW6k0MkW7tjcKqW95Zl7f2ck6QMW6wFQ3t31QcDcN5Zgh-3HlGpCW2lzxX15fmH8sW8mS0rd4R0VrdMwt-fnZW-VXW2TkJSr5Dh8PQW1SkqjC6jBGZBW2mKjCV84VpwbN2HWJSCDKbY1W64Z0-J4KMxvvW1JxNPp4n7by0N1GrxH_p8Y0NW2zzfXh8vBsDGW7BJ-Nt8-k_lfW6RkWt319sF-WW5cbpT08k1HNNW5pCdLn3ftphDV3w38f7JYBDpN5vmwQtHWjCtN8P84F2QDh5bf3wzYCs04). You can opt out at any time. In an age where everyone is stretched to the max, here’s something quick you can do to make a real difference. We will be sending GSMT members an email with short videos, quotes, or memes that you can copy and share with your own social media, forward via email, and text messages. Share them far and wide with friends, family, neighbors, and even busy people like you! That’s all you have to do. Open an email, click to watch the videos on our website, and share on your favorite social media accounts. USA is a non-partisan organization, and our videos will reflect that. Voting is the cornerstone of our constitutional republic, and regardless of party affiliation, we all love America and want valid elections! Please take 30 seconds to click [HERE](https://d56tDQ04.na1.hubspotlinks.com/Ctc/UD+113/d56tDQ04/VVVplp1_wQbSW7NJXg28K8wKtW4lQ0X35bD3lJN2glj183m2ndW7lCdLW6lZ3mgW18ym3R1JR-f9W3THrbK3D7xcgW7nlS2c1_hr_SVNr0Qg6TJM5RW6hDWZQ5bDw01W2mvmFK47Rb_TW33BN8x7X9dhdW1NXbS66hgBm2W6j03q08M6dP-W5f320-2lYjc-W1SM9KC8NGMJ-N94xr8ZXVYZsW11BzP5816FhMW7gPBqR1x5Cz8W2ZNNLz5vZdkkVqlc0p293XZQW43BDw05cCkjmW1F-R6m6fxSb3W2v643b6F-hTSW708SR646Wn06W7hJx8h8ycfqhW2vnJtp8kv_m1W8Q1xS511P7_3MH1Wd-XW7J6f12Lt9T04) to join our Grassroots Social Media Team. clean_body: USA is starting an exciting new outreach program that anyone can participate in, regardless of how busy they might be. | Thank you for your support for United Sovereign Americans (USA) and our efforts to bring our elections back into compliance with the law. You have either offered to volunteer (thanks!), made a donation (Thanks!), done volunteer work for us (THANKS!), or just asked to be kept informed about our activities. The only way we can solve this dilemma of elections that are so flawed they are meaningless, is to take action. One of those actions is to share what you know about valid elections with friends, neighbors, and family. 90% of Americans actively use social media accounts, and they are a great way to spread the word about our election concerns. USA is starting an exciting new outreach program that anyone can participate in, regardless of how busy they might be. It’s called the Grassroots Social Media Team (GSMT), and we will be creating short videos that explain why all Americans, regardless of political party, should care about honest and accurate elections. Check out our first three videos It will take just a few minutes of your time, 1-3 times a week. You can sign up to join our special GSMT email list . You can opt out at any time. In an age where everyone is stretched to the max, here’s something quick you can do to make a real difference. We will be sending GSMT members an email with short videos, quotes, or memes that you can copy and share with your own social media, forward via email, and text messages. Share them far and wide with friends, family, neighbors, and even busy people like you! That’s all you have to do. Open an email, click to watch the videos on our website, and share on your favorite social media accounts. USA is a non-partisan organization, and our videos will reflect that. Voting is the cornerstone of our constitutional republic, and regardless of party affiliation, we all love America and want valid elections! Please take 30 seconds to click to join our Grassroots Social Media Team. Thanks again for your support! Marly Hornik and Harry Haury, United Sovereign Americans | United Sovereign Americans, Inc., a 501(c)(4) nonprofit organization, Suite 194, 167 LAMP & LANTERN VILLAGE, CHESTERFIELD, MO 63017

Peter,
I was recently visiting with my 95-year old father (his name is Ed, and he lives in sunny Boca Raton, so he is known as BocaEddy) and he reminded me about a photo that — well I just _had_ to share it with you.
Here you go. Me at 13, in all my “glory” at my Bar Mitzvah:
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/80854247/460620837/443154033?amount=3&refcode=UTS_FR_90DC_240313_2_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNy8xLzg5NDc2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjAyNjY3N2Q0LTM0ZTEtZWUxMS04NWY5LTAwMjI0ODIyMzg0OCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=nJTF6e133h1MaBMDItoCVwJrRbDmTTFjwwS1-tAhUV0=)

Throughout my career in public service, I’ve thought a lot about the Jewish tradition of “Tikkun Olam,” or repairing the world. And over the last few years, there has been a lot that was broken, and a lot to fix. It’s been my cause.

I want to take you back to 1973. Our family moved around a lot because my father was in the “schmata” business. He started as a traveling salesman, and later worked as a regional manager for a men’s clothing company.
We moved from Massachusetts where I was born, lived a few years in Arizona, and ended up in the Bay Area. It was there where my dad got out of the clothing business and bought a lumber yard, where I worked during the summers. There’s nothing like hauling sheets of plywood and roofing, and shoveling concrete to make you want to go to graduate school.
This photo was taken when my family was a member of Temple Isaiah in Lafayette, California, a reform synagogue we joined after moving to the Bay Area. And it came after months of practicing for my Bar Mitzvah. I even taped my practice sessions on our tape recorder (I have a copy of that tape somewhere, believe it or not, voice cracking and all.)
While the Hebrew language skills I quickly acquired were just as quickly lost, the lessons that my faith taught me endure and guide me to this day.

name: Craig Segall, Evergreen
subject: Get excited with me, friend.
body:
This new plan is the key to electrifying our freight sector
| | | | [](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2398009/87SdQ4wZ) |
---|---|---
---
| Hi friend,

The wheels of our economy wouldn't turn without heavy-duty vehicles, but the dirty fuels that power them are literally killing us.

Millions of Americans—predominantly in low-income, Black, and Latino communities—living near ports and highways breathe pollution from trucks and locomotives so dangerous that many activists call their neighborhoods "diesel death zones."

A **new, highly-anticipated announcement from the Biden administration** offers an opportunity to address this injustice by **electrifying our entire freight system by 2040.** The plan, announced this week, enables the **biggest-ever coordinated federal investment to electrify our freight industry** —cutting deadly air pollution, creating hundreds of thousands of clean energy jobs, and fighting climate change—all while keeping our supply chains and economy pushing full-steam ahead. |
---
[SEE HOW](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2398010/87SdQ4wZ)
---
---
| This win wouldn't have been possible without decades of advocacy from frontline communities and movement leaders working hand-in-hand with the Biden administration to find a solution.

As one of the groups that advocated for this strategy, I can't stress enough how important this announcement is. [**We break down everything you need to know about the new plan, charging infrastructure, and clean trucks in our latest explainer blog.**](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2398011/87SdQ4wZ)

I hope you'll check it out and share in my excitement!

Onward, |
---
| | | [ ](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2398012/87SdQ4wZ)
---
### Craig Segall
Vice President
Evergreen Collaborative

subject: Jim Himes Votes AGAINST the Laken Riley Act
body:

|

---
March 13, 2024 Most of us have learned of the story of the tragic murder of Laken Riley, the University of Georgia nursing student who was murdered while jogging on campus. She was murdered, allegedly by Antonio Ibarra, an illegal immigrant from Venezuela, who had already been held by Athens, GA police for theft from a local Walmart. Outrage has centered on the fact that GA police had Ibarra in custody but failed to turn him over to Immigration authorities (ICE). Normal Americans consider the lenient treatment of illegal immigrants in our country an irresponsible menace to the public... or worse. As a result of this episode, House leadership put up [H.R. 7511](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001pbEyQva0c0RcD0IaowV1lhopzKV3BpeADr9l3DXOW4ult4YVmbvhFlbdwf6l4l3nJPNCnZ-dRldD7RfRQ7iu3appCKb4fgq-h7oK7IBouEgnadYZFBvaOOlpt1Hfxk_zoT02oqFqHFVASWyOqjxuH_zyMCf8mRY8Zc0qSKB1g6Xju5KkFt6Jikj8XvuO_URl&c=6tP3F5CD63WV8LCM7dJjf0ndoKll_CdpMsXHeyW4zTdY00akyueS-Q==&ch=_jnn8sBpA8-fr8iVW4PlQpmJ5al5IoOHwym2IypkKG3CgzUAEEK8Sw==), the 'Laken Riley Act' for a vote. The bill calls for the detention by ICE of illegal immigrants implicated in local theft or burglary charges. Bottom line is that Ibarra never should have been free to commit the heinous crime. Laken Riley is just the latest in long list of victims of illegal immigrant crime over the past decade and more. The Laken Riley Act seeks to finally prevent such horrific crimes going forward. And infuriatingly, Jim Himes voted AGAINST the Laken Riley Act! You could give his Stamford office a piece of your mind over his continued mis-representation of our interests at 203-353-9400. Let him and his staff explain his latest vote against the citizenry he's sworn to protect. Meanwhile, in this update I planned to recount some recent campaign activities, but Mr. Himes had to strike with yet another vote which could not go un-noted. In other campaign news.......... There are 17 towns in the 4th District. I've presented my candidacy to each of them over the past year, and I'm now coming back thru each with an update, seeking feedback, answering questions, networking and gathering support with an eye toward the nominating convention in May. Reception has been positive, and always includes a group of members who are enthusiastic that there's a fighter taking a bead on the always slippery and deceptive, Jim Himes. In recent months I've met with small business leaders at several meetings of the Bridgeport Regional Business Council. I was the keynote speaker at the January meeting of the Fairfield County Commercial Brokers Network. I discussed the challenges of Affordable Housing with the directors of Connecticut Housing Partners. Pitched my candidacy to a meeting of the Greater Education Council of Connecticut. Was interviewed about my book, The Seventh Crisis, on Public TV. Met some solid activists at the Connecticut Republican Assembly annual convention. Met Congressman James Comer, Chair of the House Oversight Committee. At CPAC I met Congressman Matt Gaetz, former Congressman Dave Bratt, and gave a brief pitch for my candidacy on Steve Bannon's live podcast. I also met the great Brit, Nigel Farage, originator and leader of the BREXIT movement. Overcoming the challenges, as many of these leaders have, provides continual inspiration for my efforts in this campaign. As I elaborated in an update earlier this year, the solutions to many of our national challenges lie in the following: * Securing Our Border * Cutting Inflation and Restoring our Economy * Unwavering Support for Parents' Rights * Reclaiming Our Energy Independence * Crushing Crime and Restoring Public Safety * Offering Security, Opportunities and Choice in Our Cities * A Smart Peace-Through-Strength, Strong National Defense It's been a generation or more since all the major issues, most important to a majority of Americans, have been firmly aligned with our principles and legislative efforts. The political terrain before us is fertile for our message. I'll be doing everything possible in the next eight months to gather the support and ultimately the votes to prevail in unseating Mr. Himes in November. Radical Jim Himes is NO Moderate
The 2024 election will be a referendum on Jim Himes' failed 15-year rule. Solid citizens can donate to retire this man right here: [DONATE](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001pbEyQva0c0RcD0IaowV1lhopzKV3BpeADr9l3DXOW4ult4YVmbvhFvwoHG_9Vmi3e5Pb88u3doNX00RYiA-gPPsGf20iqWjrODhX5YTnlw1BR6CWL22oFODJ1T9LOHaedV11dCNzhA6Mlivs-vuFdwxnjtaN1oapU9y1IfFxQLCctD8MSSeiJN-2QpchwGLpImybQ_qSpUOsMtPoDNoHFar1V2IeWTrntKdNdP1J7zE=&c=6tP3F5CD63WV8LCM7dJjf0ndoKll_CdpMsXHeyW4zTdY00akyueS-Q==&ch=_jnn8sBpA8-fr8iVW4PlQpmJ5al5IoOHwym2IypkKG3CgzUAEEK8Sw==) It's critical for my campaign, and would be deeply appreciated. Please re-circulate this message to any and all who are interested...or should be. Help is on the way,
Bob MacGuffie Candidate for Congress [www.BobMacforCongress.com](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001pbEyQva0c0RcD0IaowV1lhopzKV3BpeADr9l3DXOW4ult4YVmbvhFv8Z80rw9aqkmxRX6LxiJR_4WqBiS5A5ZQpXyzstYNWxlfdlE4QfNVkgWwD9KlPOUFBEIOY16wlQEojP1ycgL0Cz0e2HdeOOFW5XiRldHMNQ&c=6tP3F5CD63WV8LCM7dJjf0ndoKll_CdpMsXHeyW4zTdY00akyueS-Q==&ch=_jnn8sBpA8-fr8iVW4PlQpmJ5al5IoOHwym2IypkKG3CgzUAEEK8Sw==)

If everyone reading this donated $3 to Elissa Slotkin’s Senate campaign, we would not only have a huge number of donations, but we would reach the incremental goals we need to hit in order to win this race and keep Michigan’s Senate seat BLUE.
Unfortunately, not everyone gives. And the fact that Elissa rejects corporate PAC money makes things harder than they could be. [**So she's relying on people who understand how important this race is -- and Michigan is -- to chip-in before our FEC deadline ends.](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-mar24.YRUw2h&refcode=em240313-1-700&t=2&akid=1214%2E135344%2EC3hhDL)**

The DeVos family has supported opponents of Elissa in the past, and it looks like they’re ready to double down on this Senate race.
Republican Mike Rogers' first FEC report was filled with donations from a bunch of members of the DeVos family -- contributions totaling $46,200 all made on one single day.
By contrast, the majority of the donations we receive come from people contributing significantly smaller donations than the DeVos family made to Mike Rogers.

The U.S.’ national deficit surged in February as income declined and
expenses rose, resulting in the federal government spending more than

**Press Contact** : Damon Drew
damon@emiliasykesforcongress.com
---
| **Rep. Emilia Sykes Wins Endorsement from Defend The Vote ** **Defend The Vote is dedicated to passing protecting voting rights and defending democracy**
---
| Akron, OH - Rep. Emilia Sykes today has earned the endorsement of Defend The Vote (DTV), one of the nation’s leading and most influential pro-democracy organizations.

“Every Ohioan in the 13th Congressional District deserves to have their voices heard and votes counted,” Sykes said. “I’m fighting to protect the freedom to vote, hold accountable anyone who attacks our free and fair elections or advocates for political violence. I am grateful to have Defend The Vote partnering with us in this fight and thankful for their support."

Sykes is a leader in the U.S. House of Representatives on protecting and expanding the right to vote, ending dark money, and ensuring democracy works for everyone. She has cosponsored the Freedom to Vote Act and John R. Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act and supports funding for local election workers to run safe and accessible elections without threat of harassment or intimidation and to prevent the spread of misinformation. Her work in Congress is pivotal to passing legislation that protects every American’s right to vote in safe, accessible, transparent elections.

“Rep. Sykes believes our democracy should work for everyone, not just the wealthy and powerful. She is leading efforts in Congress to pass reforms ensuring political leaders listen to the voices of the people, abide by the rule of law, and are held accountable when they don’t,” DTV Executive Director Brian Lemek said. “We need Emilia Sykes in Congress fighting to protect our rights and freedoms, and Defend The Vote is proud to support her.”

Defend The Vote has emerged as one of the nation’s leading and most influential pro-democracy organizations. It is dedicated to electing pro-voting rights candidates, up and down the ballot, who will preserve our democracy by fighting to safeguard free and fair elections, protect the right to vote, and increase voter access. Last cycle, DTV helped elect 55 pro-democracy House candidates and five Senate candidates.

JD Vance

# [](https://go.bobcasey.com/go/181?t=1&akid=2296%2E552475%2Er3278y)
Bob Casey is running for Senate to cut through the gridlock, stand up to powerful corporate special interests, and fight for hardworking Pennsylvanians. [**This is poised to be one of the most competitive elections in the country, so if you’re with us, chip in today.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240313-1?refcode=em20240313-1&recurring=1&refcode2=2296_552475_r3278y&akid=2296%2E552475%2Er3278y)
* * *
I love Scranton, Peter.
It’s where I grew up, it’s where Terese and I raised our four daughters, and it’s where I’m proud to still call home today.
Every week, when I make my way home from Washington, traveling on Amtrak and 476, Scranton is my final destination.
When people ask why we chose to make Scranton our home, I tell them it's because of the people.
When I’m grocery shopping, “hello” or “how’s it going?” in the checkout line always leads to an engaging conversation. Neighbors don’t just say “hello” back and go on with their day. They’re going to tell you about what they’re buying and about their family — and they’ll ask you about what you’re buying and about your family too.
These conversations remind me how hard Pennsylvanians work to provide for their kids, save for their families’ futures, and give back to their communities. It reminds me why I’m fighting for the people of our Commonwealth in the Senate. They deserve a Senator on their side.
Peter, I’m running for re-election to continue fighting for Pennsylvania families, but the reality is, this is going to be my toughest race yet.
My opponent is worth hundreds of millions of dollars and will be another “yes” vote for big corporations and the ultra-wealthy like him in the Senate. That’s why Wall Street billionaires are trying so hard to defeat me and flip this seat. A right-wing super PAC already dumped $1 million into this race to attack me and boost my opponent, and there are millions more on the way.
[**With the Senate majority hinging on this seat, your support is more important than ever. Will you pitch in $5 or more today to keep PA and the Senate blue?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240313-1?refcode=em20240313-1&recurring=1&refcode2=2296_552475_r3278y&akid=2296%2E552475%2Er3278y)

| | The cost of elections has become a national problem, and we must find a better way to manage the democratic process of elevating individuals to the role of public servants. According to [NBC News](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/ebOuuGMQz/c?w=84h0qiLki6eZEpliLwfjlLL2XSsOqxX2uuyWObaZw3k.), the cost of elections is estimated to be four times higher in 2024 than in 2016. With each battleground and high-profile election, costs are reaching unprecedented levels, often unjustified.
---
| |
---
| | Election cycle politics primarily focuses on fundraising and winning the election. However, I believe both of these goals are flawed. Firstly, fundraising is not merely about appropriately funding a race; it has become an industry where profitability is the primary goal. This has led to an uncomfortable arrangement between politicians, constituents, and consultants. Politicians are pressured to raise sufficient funds to avoid losing, constituents are persuaded to donate to ensure their candidate's success, and consultants operate within this system.

| | In 2022, the top four Senate races collectively spent close to $600 million, arguably far beyond what was needed. The proportionality no longer makes sense and this leads to my second contention on whether winning an election is the correct goal? A presidential election is undoubtedly crucial, but for the House and Senate, retaining control of their respective chambers is paramount. According to [FEC-reported finances](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/ebOuuGMQz/c?w=wG4eTcs9wvQ0E2ebHtyrhWjs_zTt_0Xkgz8uamR_7Uk.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZmVjLmdvdi91cGRhdGVzL3N0YXRpc3RpY2FsLXN1bW1hcnktb2YtMTgtbW9udGgtY2FtcGFpZ24tYWN0aXZpdHktb2YtdGhlLTIwMjEtMjAyMi1lbGVjdGlvbi1jeWNsZS8iLCJyIjoiZjI2Y2IzNDQtNjZiZS00Y2Q5LWJkNzEtMjUyNzhiMDBlNTNhIiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiMjc3ZTdmNGEtMDBlMy00OGZjLWJiOTctNjU0YjNmYTM3NGE4In0) for Senate and House races from 2018 to 2022, the average spending for a Senate race was $3 million, while a House seat averaged a mere $665,000. It's perplexing to consider that if the $200 million raised by the top four Democrats over their Republican opponents had been distributed more evenly, rather than solely focused on holding the Senate, we might have achieved a supermajority.

It's hard to imagine that there were no other races closer to home for donors that were equally or more deserving of funding. If you live in Central or Eastern Washington, you know that we lack state representation, have no voice in the US House, and our local elections often feature disproportionately far-right candidates. | | 3\. The Darkside Of Political Excess
---
| | Did she ever have a chance? If you follow any of her social media channels, you will immediately know who [Katie Porter](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/ebOuuGMQz/c?w=xY9TYPBTLDhIMjI4v88uvmXXIpKZjTvj9p4kCqToKuo.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9wb3J0ZXIuaG91c2UuZ292LyIsInIiOiI1OGQyYTY5NS05YTk2LTQ3MDQtODJkNS01ODc1YmM4YTQ0YTgiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiIyNzdlN2Y0YS0wMGUzLTQ4ZmMtYmI5Ny02NTRiM2ZhMzc0YTgifQ) is. She was the Democratic Representative from California’s 47th district who, with little more than a whiteboard and simple math, made CEOs crumble before her. She was magnificent. So why, when she ran for Dianne Feinstein’s open seat against Adam Schiff (D) CA-30, did she get treated so poorly? In an article by The [Washington Post](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/ebOuuGMQz/c?w=kG2i3-K2fJleTSpYrrMvlP5Q8a56bh4-l7eJd-w2QTA.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cud2FzaGluZ3RvbnBvc3QuY29tL2VsZWN0aW9ucy8yMDI0LzAyLzI5L2FkYW0tc2NoaWZmLWthdGllLXBvcnRlci1zdGV2ZS1nYXJ2ZXktY2FsaWZvcm5pYS1zZW5hdGUtcmFjZS8iLCJyIjoiNThkMmE2OTUtOWE5Ni00NzA0LTgyZDUtNTg3NWJjOGE0NGE4IiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiMjc3ZTdmNGEtMDBlMy00OGZjLWJiOTctNjU0YjNmYTM3NGE4In0), it was made clear that Schiff and supporters spent $11 million to ensure she did not make it through the primary. Your first thought might be that he spent it on his advertising, but you would be wrong. You might think he ran negative ads against her, and whereas that would be cheap, it would still be within the rules, but you would be wrong. If you guessed that he ran ads to promote the Republican opponent Steve Garvey so that he would get through the jungle primary (top two vote-getters), you would be right. I have seen low in my day, but that is beyond the pale. Katie Porter had more adversaries than just Schiff. An article published by [Slate](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/ebOuuGMQz/c?w=_AFkVXRiV9UG_zUEfZfNfYR8O3uEcL7aB_FLiWj3l8I.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9zbGF0ZS5jb20vbmV3cy1hbmQtcG9saXRpY3MvMjAyNC8wMy9jYWxpZm9ybmlhLWRlbW9jcmF0cy1wb3J0ZXItc2VuYXRlLXNjaGlmZi1nYXJ2ZXktcmlnZ2VkLmh0bWwiLCJyIjoiNThkMmE2OTUtOWE5Ni00NzA0LTgyZDUtNTg3NWJjOGE0NGE4IiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiMjc3ZTdmNGEtMDBlMy00OGZjLWJiOTctNjU0YjNmYTM3NGE4In0) stated that the [Winklevoss twins](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/ebOuuGMQz/c?w=A-MlHiAgEFo_Wk8woxCMEhtZLEItQCeI5zU8Qw9PiYU.) kicked in another $5 million to make sure she did not make it through the primary. Do the simple math here: Adam Schiff was so intimidated by her capability that he spent a huge sum to promote a Republican opponent to shut her out, and the Winklevoss twins spent $5 million of their own money to make sure she did not get the Senate Seat. To me, that adds up to the best replacement for the bigger-than-life career of Dianne Feinstein not going to the best person, but to the person who was able to raise such an excess of campaign money he had enough to ruin another Democrat. Next time you are writing a donation check, remember that you know your neighbors best and our struggle is equal or more than anyone else.

In an article by The , it was made clear that Schiff and supporters spent $11 million to ensure she did not make it through the primary. Your first thought might be that he spent it on his advertising, but you would be wrong. You might think he ran negative ads against her, and whereas that would be cheap, it would still be within the rules, but you would be wrong. If you guessed that he ran ads to promote the Republican opponent Steve Garvey so that he would get through the jungle primary (top two vote-getters), you would be right. I have seen low in my day, but that is beyond the pale. Katie Porter had more adversaries than just Schiff. An article published by stated that the kicked in another $5 million to make sure she did not make it through the primary. Do the simple math here: Adam Schiff was so intimidated by her capability that he spent a huge sum to promote a Republican opponent to shut her out, and the Winklevoss twins spent $5 million of their own money to make sure she did not get the Senate Seat. To me, that adds up to the best replacement for the bigger-than-life career of Dianne Feinstein not going to the best person, but to the person who was able to raise such an excess of campaign money he had enough to ruin another Democrat. Next time you are writing a donation check, remember that you know your neighbors best and our struggle is equal or more than anyone else. | | 4. He got into some legal trouble in recent years for his role in helping a woman named Sarah Stanley take her three-year-old daughter and keep the girl from her father, who had been granted full custody of the child.
