subject: Washington D.C. betrayed my son
body:
I know you and I have never met. But I’m praying that you’ll help me save my son, Officer Terence Sutton.

Dear friend,

I know you and I have never met. But I'm praying that you'll help me save my son, Officer Terence Sutton.

This is a picture of Terence and me at a dinner celebrating his graduation from the Police Academy.
[](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/qaxVNNTmLo3cRIp---pt8w~~/AARclAA~/RgRn1GaoP0SVaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9sZWxkZi85NmMxM2ViYy1iNTc1LTQ1NTYtOTg5Ni1iNTBmMTA5MWVlZTA_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVOJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjQwMzEzX0JER19MRUxERl9TTUxQX1JFTl9QQS1ST05XA3NwY0IKZe-uz_FlQKt5hFIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)
I was so proud that night. But I was also terrified.

Terence was going to be patrolling the streets of Washington, DC, where crime is sky-high and politicians side with criminals over cops. But never in my wildest imagination could I have predicted that my son would be _wrongfully_ _convicted_ _of_ _murder_ **- murder of a criminal my son didn't even touch.**

The story is so shocking that if it didn't happen to my son, _I wouldn 't even believe it._ **[And I'm praying you will help me save my son](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/qaxVNNTmLo3cRIp---pt8w~~/AARclAA~/RgRn1GaoP0SVaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9sZWxkZi85NmMxM2ViYy1iNTc1LTQ1NTYtOTg5Ni1iNTBmMTA5MWVlZTA_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVOJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjQwMzEzX0JER19MRUxERl9TTUxQX1JFTl9QQS1ST05XA3NwY0IKZe-uz_FlQKt5hFIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)** - **but first, let me explain what happened.**

Our nightmare started in October of 2020.

Terence was sitting in his patrol car when he received a report that a known gang member, Karon Hylton-Brown, was seen entering a rival gang's territory.

Karon was a violent criminal with a rap sheet a mile long - including drugs, illegal gun possession, and assaults. Earlier that day, he had been seen arguing with a rival gang member who owed him money. Terence and other officers were concerned Karon was planning to get revenge.

So when Terence saw him illegally driving a motorized scooter on the sidewalk without a helmet, he tried to pull Karon over to talk. Instead, Karon took off on the scooter.

Terence watched as Karon sped through traffic, weaving in and out of cars and blowing past red lights and stop signs.

My son knew Karon was putting others at risk, so for 3 minutes he slowly and carefully followed behind in his patrol car.

And then it happened.

Karon veered into an alleyway, drove out the other side without looking and slammed into a passing car.

After several days in the hospital, Karon died from his injuries. And here's where the story takes a shocking turn...

Because Karon was black, and the incident happened just four months after George Floyd's death, the anti-police mob went into frenzy.

They blamed Terence for the accident and smeared him as a racist.

There were protests and even riots. The mob threw rocks at officers, smashed store windows, and set fires.

Anti-police politicians piled on too. Without any evidence, they demanded my son be charged even though he did nothing to cause Karon's death.

The pressure campaign worked, and prosecutors charged my son with _**Second-Degree Murder.**_

When Terence called to tell me about the charges, I was in disbelief. Any sane person could see that Karon's death, while tragic, was no one's fault but his own.

_He_ chose to run from the cops.

_He_ chose to not wear a helmet.

_He_ chose to speed through that alley without looking where he was going.

So, when I learned that Terence could be sentenced to **_sixty_ _years_** in prison for Karon's death, my head started spinning. And it only got worse when the trial began.

You see, the judge refused to allow Terence's legal team to present all of the facts in his defense.

The jury never got to hear that Karon was a known member of a violent gang...

They never got to hear that he was wearing an ankle monitor because of a violent assault he had committed just weeks before...

They never got to hear that he had drugs and thousands of dollars in cash strapped to his leg...

And they never got to hear about the drugs in Karon's system at the time of the crash.

Sitting in the courtroom, I couldn't believe my ears when the jury filed out and declared Terence _**" guilty."**_

He's currently awaiting sentencing.

Now you understand why I'm so heartbroken. The injustice is almost too much to bear.

My son was well-respected by the community he served. He trained many Rookies and set a good example for all of them.

He was even awarded Officer of the Year!

And at the same time the bleeding-heart DC politicians are letting shoplifters, carjackers, and drug dealers walk away scot-free...

...they're trying to put my son - a decorated officer who has received 60 awards and commendations - away for 60 years for something he _didn 't_ _do._

I had almost lost hope, but then we learned about the **Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund** -or LELDF for short.

If you've ever heard of LELDF, you know they're a national group fighting on behalf of wrongly-accused police officers like Terence. LELDF has helped dozens of innocent cops - and their families - at their lowest moments. And when I got the call from their president, Jason Johnson, I was at my lowest moment.

Not only did LELDF decide to help my son get the legal defense he deserves. They're also raising money to pay for the best attorneys and expert witnesses for Terence.

So I have to ask you one of the toughest questions I've ever asked anyone:

**[Will you help my son Terence fight the unjust charges against him by donating to LELDF?](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/qaxVNNTmLo3cRIp---pt8w~~/AARclAA~/RgRn1GaoP0SVaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9sZWxkZi85NmMxM2ViYy1iNTc1LTQ1NTYtOTg5Ni1iNTBmMTA5MWVlZTA_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVOJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjQwMzEzX0JER19MRUxERl9TTUxQX1JFTl9QQS1ST05XA3NwY0IKZe-uz_FlQKt5hFIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)**

To fund his defense, Terence had to sell his home, his car, his beloved motorcycle, and most of his personal belongings. Everything he owns now fits in just nine small boxes. He has almost nothing left.

If I had anywhere else to turn, I wouldn't be so bold as to ask for your help.

But I already lost my husband. He was a police officer too, and he was so proud that Terence followed in his footsteps. And it makes me cry when I think of how he would feel about what Terence is being put through right now.

I simply can't bear the thought of having another family member ripped away from me.

**[So if you are at all able, would you consider following this link to make a tax-deductible donation to the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund to help my Terence?](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/qaxVNNTmLo3cRIp---pt8w~~/AARclAA~/RgRn1GaoP0SVaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9sZWxkZi85NmMxM2ViYy1iNTc1LTQ1NTYtOTg5Ni1iNTBmMTA5MWVlZTA_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVOJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjQwMzEzX0JER19MRUxERl9TTUxQX1JFTl9QQS1ST05XA3NwY0IKZe-uz_FlQKt5hFIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)**

**Any amount - $35, $50, $100, or even $500 or more - will help.**

And because LELDF is a non-profit organization, your gift is completely tax-deductible. But whatever you can afford to give, I ask that you rush it back quickly.

Terence's team is currently looking at every available option to keep his case alive.

**[And you and your $35 contribution could make the difference in Terence being acquitted or spending the next 60 years behind bars.](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/qaxVNNTmLo3cRIp---pt8w~~/AARclAA~/RgRn1GaoP0SVaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9sZWxkZi85NmMxM2ViYy1iNTc1LTQ1NTYtOTg5Ni1iNTBmMTA5MWVlZTA_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVOJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjQwMzEzX0JER19MRUxERl9TTUxQX1JFTl9QQS1ST05XA3NwY0IKZe-uz_FlQKt5hFIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)**

Right now, Terence can only rely on the good nature and generosity of kind neighbors like you.

Thank you for taking the time to read my letter today.

And thank you - in advance - for doing what you can to help all the wrongly-accused officers LELDF is working with. Like Terence.

Sincerely,

Patti Reilly

P.S. I know a few kind words from someone like you will help lift Terence's spirits. This guilty verdict has been so devastating for him. **[So if you choose to make a $35 gift to LELDF, would you also please include a little note-maybe a prayer?](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/qaxVNNTmLo3cRIp---pt8w~~/AARclAA~/RgRn1GaoP0SVaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9sZWxkZi85NmMxM2ViYy1iNTc1LTQ1NTYtOTg5Ni1iNTBmMTA5MWVlZTA_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVOJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjQwMzEzX0JER19MRUxERl9TTUxQX1JFTl9QQS1ST05XA3NwY0IKZe-uz_FlQKt5hFIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)** There's a field on the page for you to do this. Thank you -from the bottom of my heart.
--------

_More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. This week, Joe Biden released his budget proposal for the year. First thing to know, the president’s budget isn’t necessarily a real budget. It’s a statement of priorities. Second, and more importantly, this president’s priorities are wildly off-base. What does he want? —> $7.3 TRILLION in spending —> TRILLIONS in new tax increases on Americans —> A $1.8 TRILLION deficit Like the subject line said, this is a perfect example of what’s wrong with Washington. Career politicians and insiders have no regard for how their policies impact working families here in Georgia’s 3rd District, or across the country for that matter. During my time in the Georgia Senate, we balanced our budget every single year. We cut taxes four times in ten years, including the largest income tax cut in Georgia’s history. And we kept government out of the way. Congress needs an Army Ranger, and some more Georgia common sense, to hold the line against this big spending nonsense. That’s another reason why I’m running for Congress now, and I’m in it to win it.

clean_body: | | | This week, Joe Biden released his budget proposal for the year. First thing to know, the president’s budget isn’t necessarily a real budget. It’s a statement of priorities. Second, and more importantly, this president’s priorities are wildly off-base. What does he want? —> $7.3 TRILLION in spending —> TRILLIONS in new tax increases on Americans —> A $1.8 TRILLION deficit Like the subject line said, this is a perfect example of what’s wrong with Washington. Career politicians and insiders have no regard for how their policies impact working families here in Georgia’s 3rd District, or across the country for that matter. During my time in the Georgia Senate, we balanced our budget every single year. We cut taxes four times in ten years, including the largest income tax cut in Georgia’s history. And we kept government out of the way. Congress needs an Army Ranger, and some more Georgia common sense, to hold the line against this big spending nonsense. That’s another reason why I’m running for Congress now, and I’m in it to win it. Friend,

I'm the product of an unplanned pregnancy.

Born to two teenage parents, every statistic and societal roadblock indicated that I was destined for a life of hardship.

But my parents didn't buy into any of that.

I may have been unplanned, but that did not mean I was unwanted.

Soon after me, three more kids came. And what began as a teenage love story quickly became a family of six. My dad went to work and did whatever he needed to do to make ends meet for our family. That meant putting his life on the line to serve his community in the local fire department.

All my life, I wanted to be like my dad, and there was nothing I dreamed of more than becoming a firefighter just like him.

But on a fateful day in September of 1984, all of that changed.

My dad and his battalion responded to a call that would change all of our lives forever.

By the grace of God my dad made it out of that building alive, but not unscathed. Eighty percent of his body was covered in burns.

From then on, the hardest working man that I knew would not be able to work as a fireman another day of his life. And as the oldest of four kids, it was up to me to step in and help fill the void in our young family.

We're all a product of our experiences, and that moment defined who I am.

My dream of becoming a firefighter like my dad was now discouraged, and I had effectively been launched into the role of a pseudo-parent to my younger siblings overnight.

**Being raised in a Christian household without a lot of means, we put our head down for two reasons:

1\. To pray to God
2\. To get to work**

So, at 12 years old, I picked myself up by my bootstraps and did just that -- got to work.

And to be quite honest, I haven't really picked my head back up since.

From a young boy trying to help his parents make ends meet, to a law student, to a husband and father, and eventually to Speaker of the House, the only thing I have ever been focused on is getting the job done.

My wife might call me a workaholic, but in my mind, I am a man who is focused on the task at hand, and completing a mission.

**[Right now, my mission is to ensure that my kids have the same opportunity to make a life for themselves and achieve their goals like I did.](https://links.greatamericatoday.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=0f098c3c47734ef2a2eb8f42c21727ff&_e=r0PwCVaa5wvBm-IGXxBti2Wfls9TMq92tUHhr5fVrEbX4d5gXjeJmWtmN1gP2_XT7pGE_qynmv4Q_ovtgy4ljJP3eF2rVSwBq4jw-NV3oWvl__nh9bAMdDlw6HLkA2pZYHmejfpjxsLN9gjCSSPG_rZI9pvrZy3Co52HpkLEoUVHrtOx7y0uJgbQoWHQFa2u7DzEBlEXG76X47zOqOEjtt9ztZT3A5HyZ1X1LOwQGnDrVThx1S-P8JRUa47376_qmK2uvddia94q2hVcDQfKr2gPtkkKiNzbTHp20PXCYd_lTuuJt8Ub1lvDKPIBUquFoz2WVA9PWvjccqEjGUmRuelNyxEFTxhQayxvphcZ2h1sGdNLdUoE9SWcmkZ1IYKDVQs3SK6kikm0RwEx2NSdc75AnYWwaDpKZcd3bqU2W8GogKy5krPd5g1NX_F7i8E2bBYdO4EuiJ4QzH0T4jH1gpfC_fOCjDjrCzpBsCP2_RT5m1TcodQtZnrnVzaap0Fja2XC0BpRhbbENTotFZteXw%3D%3D "Right now, my mission is to ensure that my kids have the same opportunity to make a life for themselves and achieve their goals like I did. ")**

And that means being the kind of conservative, Christian leader in Washington, D.C. that my dad would be proud of.

That alone puts you at odds with the D.C. Establishment, by the way.

I'm not interested in the cocktail parties, or rubbing elbows with different special interest groups.

The Washington Elite and their allies in the mainstream media can cast judgment all they want. That doesn't bother me.

Because at the end of the day, I know that I serve an audience of one -- and that I am doing all that I can with the blessings given to me, and the faith entrusted to me, to glorify God.

**[So, now that you know just a little bit more about me, where I come from, and what keeps me going, I humbly ask if you are willing to stand alongside me in this fight?](https://links.greatamericatoday.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=0f098c3c47734ef2a2eb8f42c21727ff&_e=r0PwCVaa5wvBm-IGXxBti2Wfls9TMq92tUHhr5fVrEbX4d5gXjeJmWtmN1gP2_XT7pGE_qynmv4Q_ovtgy4ljJP3eF2rVSwBq4jw-NV3oWvl__nh9bAMdDlw6HLkA2pZYHmejfpjxsLN9gjCSSPG_rZI9pvrZy3Co52HpkLEoUVHrtOx7y0uJgbQoWHQFa2u7DzEBlEXG76X47zOqOEjtt9ztZT3A5HyZ1X1LOwQGnDrVThx1S-P8JRUa47376_qmK2uvddia94q2hVcDQfKr2gPtkkKiNzbTHp20PXCYd_lTuuJt8Ub1lvDKPIBUquFoz2WVA9PWvjccqEjGUmRuelNyxEFTxhQayxvphcZ2h1sGdNLdUoE9SWcmkZ1IYKDTCV2cqpTfGG0lUfsXKoYVFta5AGcgmSdaUodN1bwJYsXI9wNZFvE95rf2lpuEQenBp_4zSUno5FF4Tawfh7gfYS0MHh1NTR4DFyQ399Ddd0u4-szyjpdyStaBJN5FpvRCnWCZnC-hu44HenTWDPGVA%3D%3D "So, now that you know just a little bit more about me, where I come from, and what keeps me going, I humbly ask if you are willing to stand alongside me in this fight? clean_body: I serve God first | | | | | | Friend, I'm the product of an unplanned pregnancy. Born to two teenage parents, every statistic and societal roadblock indicated that I was destined for a life of hardship. But my parents didn't buy into any of that. I may have been unplanned, but that did not mean I was unwanted. Soon after me, three more kids came. And what began as a teenage love story quickly became a family of six. My dad went to work and did whatever he needed to do to make ends meet for our family. That meant putting his life on the line to serve his community in the local fire department. All my life, I wanted to be like my dad, and there was nothing I dreamed of more than becoming a firefighter just like him. But on a fateful day in September of 1984, all of that changed. My dad and his battalion responded to a call that would change all of our lives forever. By the grace of God my dad made it out of that building alive, but not unscathed. Eighty percent of his body was covered in burns. From then on, the hardest working man that I knew would not be able to work as a fireman another day of his life. And as the oldest of four kids, it was up to me to step in and help fill the void in our young family. We're all a product of our experiences, and that moment defined who I am. My dream of becoming a firefighter like my dad was now discouraged, and I had effectively been launched into the role of a pseudo-parent to my younger siblings overnight. Being raised in a Christian household without a lot of means, we put our head down for two reasons: 1\. To pray to God 2\. To get to work So, at 12 years old, I picked myself up by my bootstraps and did just that -- got to work. And to be quite honest, I haven't really picked my head back up since. From a young boy trying to help his parents make ends meet, to a law student, to a husband and father, and eventually to Speaker of the House, the only thing I have ever been focused on is getting the job done. My wife might call me a workaholic, but in my mind, I am a man who is focused on the task at hand, and completing a mission. "Right now, my mission is to ensure that my kids have the same opportunity to make a life for themselves and achieve their goals like I did. " And that means being the kind of conservative, Christian leader in Washington, D.C. that my dad would be proud of. That alone puts you at odds with the D.C. Establishment, by the way. I'm not interested in the cocktail parties, or rubbing elbows with different special interest groups. The Washington Elite and their allies in the mainstream media can cast judgment all they want. That doesn't bother me. Because at the end of the day, I know that I serve an audience of one -- and that I am doing all that I can with the blessings given to me, and the faith entrusted to me, to glorify God. "So, now that you know just a little bit more about me, where I come from, and what keeps me going, I humbly ask if you are willing to stand alongside me in this fight? " | | I'm not going to lie to you, it won't be easy. But doing what's right rarely is. Thank you for your time and support, | Speaker Mike Johnson * | | | Paid for by Mike Johnson for Louisiana P.O. Friend, when I was first thinking about launching this campaign last year I had no idea what to expect.
I knew I had some supporters from my congressional campaigns that I could count on, but beyond that it was a shot in the dark.
One thing I knew for sure was that whether this was a 2-way race, a 3-way race, a 27-way race, whatever — I was going to need the support of a huge grassroots team behind me. Over the last year we’ve built that team, with close to 150,000 individual donors.
And now we know: Sinema’s out. This race is a head-to-head between me and Kari Lake. And we've got to expand out that grassroots team and build a coalition here in Arizona that can defeat her.

Peter, **Bombshell testimony from FBI Director Christopher Wray this week revealed just how dangerous Biden’s Border Crisis really is.** He identified three known and clear dangers that our open border poses: **DANGEROUS DRUGS:** He warned that “the FBI alone seized enough fentanyl in the last two years to kill **270 million people**.”**DANGEROUS CRIMINALS:** He testified that there is**** “no doubt” that criminals have entered via our southern border.**DANGEROUS TERRORIST ORGANIZATIONS:** He described FBI efforts to track a smuggling network with “ISIS ties.” Peter, we’ve known that our wide-open border opened us to our nation’s enemies entering our country unmonitored. _But the FBI Director has just confirmed that it is definitely happening._ **This is utterly, completely unacceptable. The Biden Administration has failed, and put us all at risk.**
---
[**HELP ME FIGHT FOR A SECURE BORDER**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=0407f28aa93249418cafe09d8b8b3d71&_e=rQFhRXRCNSXMnq8CNtZwpFbeQe21BaX9q93J7kT1F926NIk4_4J5qZ-b_OkeGOrq9TAGFEuxdbviRPnms15QHKepg6iRjiy44MYVKkVf4_IEPf3cJfA0hWJB6ROQyNGIvvHvI-MlO0a-G16Tl7w87G3ToAFQUCM-dhMjgArwkGYPSjTHt7QUwvOw7dnlPZ4sBG3qiYz3FMUTxbdcUGoITV_di7nScgXI9qMUk2kuAu2zAGFrE3PHTre3DSTPbHpPzdB0CiVsPqActi23QeUcMSAeEdRhAdA0bsenTFF21vaZC1cUf-m03RApkFEnxZkJPNcdDnhq1z1DjqqqGL1EuRjNQZa7QLp48zXTP4V63a3o6qB9Hz-CkhqosVOUq4C3cGMAi4LpCzDxdOGciJa72k6J0NfIwXHuYPrBe5bqz2QF1dVcI-Nbs66XvuvwOfUnPgdCYLJYNkwtN1Pkv9ONJQ%3D%3D)
---
| | Every one of these dangers has invaded our country because of the Biden Administration’s deliberate refusal to secure our border. **Because Joe Biden hasn’t just failed to secure our border, he’s actively taken action to make our border insecure.** _Just ask Texas._ Remember when they put up defense wires to protect their state’s border? Some reports showed that this wire reduced illegal crossings by two-thirds. It wasn’t a wall... but it was working. So, of course, President Biden dispatched federal agents to cut down the wires — over 20 times in a single month. _Peter, they even rolled out a FORKLIFT to lift up the wire and let 300 migrants stroll on in._ This cannot stand.

---
Time is of the essence. Law and order has collapsed at our southern border. Director Wray warns that our open border means that the threat of a serious terror attack “has gone to a whole other level.” The situation is dire. Our federal government has failed us, so state leaders like myself are fighting back. We’re the last line of defense, Peter — and I won’t back down. Just this year, I...
* Sued the Biden Administration when they attempted to **redefine some illegal crossings as “lawful pathways.”**
* Filed a demand against the Biden Administration urging them to **end the catch-and-release program**.
* Joined with 26 other state attorneys general to **support Texas’ right to defend its own border**.
* _And I won’t stop fighting until our border is secure._

Peter - I’m not everyone’s cup of tea.

**_Kevin McCarthy has made that very clear._**

**Truthfully though, I don’t fit into DC because I don’t buy into the lobbyist power grabs, bureaucratic red tape, dark money swamp business.**

_Neither does President Donald J. Trump._ **We’ve seen the lengths they’ll go to take him down, and they’re doing the exact same thing to me.**

But people like President Trump and I are fighters. We don’t buy into the swamp; _we fight for the American people. We don’t sell out to corporate greed; we stand up for what is RIGHT._

We can’t be controlled, _and that scares the hell out of people who are used to puppeteering._

[** STAND WITH DONALD J. TRUMP AND NANCY MACE > **](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=302fe428c73547acb648380c5110251d&_e=zXvqWzyhTyHbS-yeicxTIXYwHXpO81ExQ-JxFE3yhSmkZRN4w-mAEMAhN79ZIZLpqFaOD7lfnyXtyESh92JbAtVA8YPeLrVX8gfiSfr8yfBzoqo5VkcLQO60TD5Djk3WYApJcR5cYvmKhigMZM8z_ftTgP-iywHou1fvShPjEZgOaSMFzGsYK8gSqw2xIOwpnoTeNFh7-qyAx1zbMd5U2yZ4IQjoJSl3PRD2X8-tY30X4geuLk7XbI3JnGRYTOL9HIdJ5oTMoa4b6KswR0lr9RUs2JOFtSviEXOeRUexX0p0VMqGHEpU43aW7p_08KnUTQ9nYrJ6FGE06C6LpZ7jr0t3qT60Cue_h2oztwbHFfHMyJFDwsYyzHLQZD5iX0mN4a9x7R_rlcJ0kF_ImmZgCQ%3D%3D)
For far too long, the wrong people have been in charge of our delicate government system here in Washington. They write blank checks with your hard-earned cash and the only people that win are the greedy politicians who profit from your demise.

[**President Trump was a disrupter and so am I.**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=302fe428c73547acb648380c5110251d&_e=zXvqWzyhTyHbS-yeicxTIXYwHXpO81ExQ-JxFE3yhSmkZRN4w-mAEMAhN79ZIZLpqFaOD7lfnyXtyESh92JbAtVA8YPeLrVX8gfiSfr8yfBzoqo5VkcLQO60TD5Djk3WYApJcR5cYvmKhigMZM8z_ftTgP-iywHou1fvShPjEZgOaSMFzGsYK8gSqw2xIOwpnoTeNFh7-qyAx1zbMd5U2yZ4IQjoJSl3PRD2X8-tY30X4geuLk7XbI3JnGRYTOL9jLmD4vDZvCDKwz5cuPx__W-UxJZ1SA_vZqvlLMtXvGMSOoU9OLqGWqwEL7MRKoVVEZnpAafe_oVZK7g6-NiYL57LuFfEr3PNxKql3prHiHTpyrTvEhurH3jMq8z9EaYtg2DqY4Z434vegoCF9BRN4w%3D%3D) I’m confident that with him on my side, Americans like you will see our mission clearly: **the mission to restore his winning policies here in our great country and make life better and easier for all.**

[**Are you with us?**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=302fe428c73547acb648380c5110251d&_e=zXvqWzyhTyHbS-yeicxTIXYwHXpO81ExQ-JxFE3yhSmkZRN4w-mAEMAhN79ZIZLpqFaOD7lfnyXtyESh92JbAtVA8YPeLrVX8gfiSfr8yfBzoqo5VkcLQO60TD5Djk3WYApJcR5cYvmKhigMZM8z_ftTgP-iywHou1fvShPjEZgOaSMFzGsYK8gSqw2xIOwpnoTeNFh7-qyAx1zbMd5U2yZ4IQjoJSl3PRD2X8-tY30X4geuLk7XbI3JnGRYTOL9BbU58C_GjhLk5IQYG-REwJD1nLi8mAEwgpWniNPUAoGH8c8njynHFwzMSD_u-B4xUCbEiBEdBAs7SNfVRhswO8XUol_6rC9FATUtKJYC8A4arHs9O9BzT4ekQWHDWI8b70Qw8Ohh6A0BYeo2U8_UoA%3D%3D)

[** DONATE > **](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=302fe428c73547acb648380c5110251d&_e=zXvqWzyhTyHbS-yeicxTIXYwHXpO81ExQ-JxFE3yhSmkZRN4w-mAEMAhN79ZIZLpqFaOD7lfnyXtyESh92JbAtVA8YPeLrVX8gfiSfr8yfBzoqo5VkcLQO60TD5Djk3WYApJcR5cYvmKhigMZM8z_ftTgP-iywHou1fvShPjEZgOaSMFzGsYK8gSqw2xIOwpnoTeNFh7-qyAx1zbMd5U2yZ4IQjoJSl3PRD2X8-tY30X4geuLk7XbI3JnGRYTOL9ULkobKF8joFvdex9RcfvCm8Qfoa0mp5C99wwQiLs7SLlinX-k-Tbf4EO0iNFrn73bYr8OO0xETvf0No_bJKe4U5YkOWGMZbed6NGIAimq-FiS-A2laWl4ZoO4AIharBVkDXaeDTiXDMtM7Qg6IhFxg%3D%3D)

Peter,

March is already here and spring is right around the corner, which means it’s almost time to start putting up lawn signs! Lawn signs are a simple, free way to show your support for the conservative cause and in a few days we’ll have hundreds of signs to distribute. If you want one, you can use the form below to request a lawn sign, a medium sign, or even a field sign.
We also need more volunteers to **help distribute signs**. If you can help with that, please add a note on the form and we’ll be in touch!

**COTTAGE GROVE
** March 21st at 4 PM
Meet at: Safeway parking lot
**JUNCTION CITY**
March 28th at 4 PM
Meet at: Safeway parking lot

**CRESWELL**
April 4th at 4 PM
Meet at: Tj's Family Restaurant parking lot
If you know which event(s) you can attend, please just reply to this email and we’ll be in touch!

| | | | | | | | |

**Oregon Board of Forestry Continues Shutting Down Forests**
Last week I showed up at the State Capitol with other loggers, concerned Oregonians, and some of our Republican legislators to stand against the Oregon Board of Forestry's devastating Habitat Conservation Plan.
This radical environmentalist plan was adopted today and will result in millions of dollars of lost revenue for local governments–meaning fewer police, firefighters, and teachers. It means thousands of private sector jobs lost.
It means furthering the divide between those of us in rural Oregon and the elite politicians and bureaucrats who have further snubbed the natural resource (and renewable) industries that once helped Oregon thrive.
As your State Representative, I will fight back. I will continue to lead the effort to restore our natural resource industries that Lane County is dependent on!
Darin Harbick

* good and evil,
* conversion and faith,
* prayer and the Bible,
* suffering and death,
* heaven and hell, and much more.

Dr. Ward is a Distinguished Visiting Professor at Hillsdale College and a member of the Faculty of Theology and Religion at the University of Oxford. He is the author of _Planet Narnia: The Seven Heavens in the Imagination of C.S. Lewis_ and _After Humanity: A Guide to C.S. Lewis 's The Abolition of Man_, and the co-editor of _The Cambridge Companion to C.S. Lewis_. He even spent three years living in Lewis's Oxford home as the resident Warden of The Kilns!

This course is especially moving because it examines C.S. Lewis's beautiful writings about faith and traces Lewis's own journey from skeptic to believer. The combination provides an opportunity for us to grow in our knowledge and understanding of Christianity.

| Peter,

It’s been an honor to represent the region where I grew up, and I care a lot about who the next representative for this region will be. That’s why I'm supporting Hilary Franz in her run for Washington’s 6th Congressional District.

My upbringing on the Olympic Peninsula shaped me as a person and as a leader. It’s why my office’s core mission has been “creating more economic opportunity for more people in more places.”

This district is diverse in all senses of the word. Our team has helped folks get broadband access, secured funding for ports to keep our small businesses competitive in a global economy, fought for rural hospitals so they can continue delivering care, stood up for Shipyard workers, helped build affordable housing in Tacoma, worked to address traffic in Gorst, secured funding to protect the Puget Sound, and so much more.

I’m proud to support Hilary because I know she has the experience and passion to serve this district in all its diverse needs. In a time when catastrophic climate events are happening with more frequency and our housing crisis is keeping too many folks from economic security, our nation needs Hilary’s experience in Congress, and Washington needs her leadership.

Now, I'm reaching out to you to join this powerful team and give Hilary the support she needs to bring the same urgency she did as our groundbreaking public lands commissioner to the other Washington.

# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20240313-1&t=1&akid=454%2E587540%2EXKjvyD)
Peter,
In November, we elected our first endorsed candidate when Nadarius Clark won his election to the Virginia Assembly. But like we said then, that race was not the finish line. Our work electing the next generation of leaders is just getting started.
Today, we're super excited to reveal our first slate of 2024 endorsed candidates! [**But first, can you rush $5 to elect these bold new leaders in November?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240313-1?refcode=em20240313-1&amount=5&refcode2=454_587540_XKjvyD&akid=454%2E587540%2EXKjvyD)
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240313-1?refcode=em20240313-1&amount=5&refcode2=454_587540_XKjvyD&akid=454%2E587540%2EXKjvyD)
**Sarah McBride (U.S. Congress — Delaware, At Large)** Sarah McBride has been a results-driven, powerhouse lawmaker in the Delaware State Senate. She passed paid family and medical leave, which was the largest expansion of Delaware’s social safety net in decades. If she wins this race in November, she would be the first trans woman elected to the U.S. Congress.
**Christine Cockley (OH HD-6 – Columbus)** Christine Cockley has spent the last several years doing racial justice work in Columbus. Her campaign is focused on health care, gun violence prevention, raising the minimum wage, and other crucial issues for her community. If elected, Christine would be the second Jewish woman elected to the Ohio House.
**Bryce Berry (GA HD-56 – Atlanta)** Bryce Berry is a middle school Algebra teacher in the Atlanta public school system. He is running for the Georgia legislature to bring positive change to his community. In his campaign, Bryce is fighting for economic development, education, health care, affordable housing, and solutions to rampant gun violence.
**Ashwin Ramaswami (GA SD-48 – Atlanta)** Ashwin Ramaswami is a second-generation Indian-American immigrant who built his career in software engineering, election security, and policy research. He is taking on Republican incumbent Rep. Shawn Still, one of the fake electors who attempted to award Georgia’s electoral votes to Donald Trump instead of Joe Biden. This is one of the most flippable seats in the Georgia Senate.
**Anna Thomas (PA HD-137 – South Central PA)** Anna Thomas is a former school board member and education advocate who is running for one of the most flippable seats in the Pennsylvania House this cycle. Anna lost this seat in the last election by only 703 votes. Winning this seat is critical to holding Democrats' two-seat majority in the Pennsylvania House.
**Anja Wookey-Huffman (MT HD-65 – Bozeman)** Anja Wookey-Huffman is a working class candidate and organizer who would be a vocal force against Montana’s MAGA movement in the statehouse. She’s ready to fight for abortion rights and take on those who stand in the way of more affordable housing who have made life hard for underserved communities and women and have priced out working class Montanans.
[**I am personally setting a $24,000 fundraising goal to build a strong foundation of support for our 2024 Leaders We Deserve candidates. If you’re as pumped about these badass progressive changemakers as I am, pitch in $5 now.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240313-1?refcode=em20240313-1&amount=5&refcode2=454_587540_XKjvyD&akid=454%2E587540%2EXKjvyD)
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240313-1?amount=5&refcode=em20240313-1-454&refcode2=454_587540_XKjvyD&akid=454%2E587540%2EXKjvyD)**
We’ll be in touch soon with more information about our endorsed candidates and we’ll keep you updated about their races from now until November. We’re going to pour everything we can into electing these young leaders all across the country.
This is exactly why Kevin and I founded Leaders We Deserve — because there are young people rising up to run for office and claim their power. But they will need a strong foundation of support to break down barriers and win these pivotal races.
[**Supporting these candidates is going to take a lot of resources. That's why reaching our $24,000 goal this week is absolutely vital. Peter, please pitch in $5 or whatever you can now to elect the next generation of leaders!**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240313-1?refcode=em20240313-1&amount=5&refcode2=454_587540_XKjvyD&akid=454%2E587540%2EXKjvyD)
Thank you!!!
David Hogg
Leaders We Deserve

name: Gabby Giffords
subject: I’m proud to endorse my friend Ruben Gallego for Senate
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
GIFFORDS needs partners like Ruben Gallego in Washington to stand up to the gun lobby and support commonsense safety measures
#

Friends,
Today, the team and I at GIFFORDS PAC are thrilled to announce we’re endorsing my friend Ruben Gallego’s campaign for US Senate in my home state of Arizona.
**If you already know that you’d like to chip in to support Ruben, please use this link to make a split contribution between GIFFORDS PAC and Ruben Gallego’s Senate campaign:**
[**https://go.giffords.org/go/Giffords-Gallego**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-mar24-gallego.rFnVqp&refcode=em240313-2-30&t=1&akid=7759%2E3935704%2E-PCpAm)
Tens of thousands of Arizona families—including mine—have seen the horror of near-constant shootings up close. That’s why GIFFORDS needs partners like Ruben Gallego in Washington to stand up to the gun lobby and support commonsense safety measures.
As a veteran and responsible gun owner, Ruben knows the importance of keeping guns out of the wrong hands. During his time in the House of Representatives, Ruben has cosponsored and voted for lifesaving legislation like the Bipartisan Background Checks Act, the Assault Weapons Ban, and Ethan’s Law. In 2022, he helped pass the Bipartisan Safer Communities Act, the first major gun safety legislation signed into law in nearly 30 years.
Our gun safety Senate majority hangs on by a thread. We must band together to make sure Ruben joins Mark in the Senate as a partner in our gun safety movement.
[**Will you please make a split contribution—of $5 or more—between GIFFORDS PAC and Ruben Gallego to help make sure we elect him to the US Senate this November?**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-mar24-gallego.rFnVqp&refcode=em240313-2-30&t=2&akid=7759%2E3935704%2E-PCpAm)

body:
Judicial Watch announced recently it filed a Freedom of Information
Act (FOIA) lawsuit against the U.S. Department of Justice for
records of all Special Counsel interviews of President Biden (Judicial
Watch, Inc. v. U.S. Department of Justice (No. 1:24-cv-00700)).

[alt_text]

My name is Katherine Clark, and I proudly serve Massachusetts’ 5th district in Congress. I am also in House leadership serving as the Democratic Whip. It wasn’t too long ago when there were hardly any women serving in Congress at all. When I first came to Congress in 2013, I was stopped and mistaken for someone’s spouse (multiple times), making it difficult to even get into the Chamber to cast a vote. Fast forward to today, and thankfully, things have improved. **There are more women serving in Congress than ever before — 94 women in the House Democratic Caucus alone!** But our work is far from over. This election, there’s so much at stake for women. name: Carmen Goers
subject: Celebrate National Working Moms Day with Carmen Goers
body:
Join the Team

| | | | | | | |
---
| | | |
---
| | | **Celebrate National **
**Working Moms Day with Me****!**
---

Dear Peter,
In recognition of National Working Moms Day, let's celebrate the remarkable dedication of working mothers across Washington's 8th congressional district and beyond. These incredible women master the art of balancing professional commitments with nurturing a family, contributing immeasurably to both their workplaces and homes.

As a single parent for nearly ten years, I remember the tough times. I worked hard to balance career and family responsibilities with grace and determination. To all moms working, we see you and celebrate the dedication, resilience, and achievements of mothers.

---
| | | |
---
|
In honor of this special day, we're inviting you to make a contribution to my campaign.

Your support of $25, $50, or $100 will help me champion the needs and rights of working mothers in Congress..

---
| [ DONATE TODAY! ](https://vgq.soundestlink.com/link/65f1f42c7fdec6c55778257a/65f0dc98378827cf1becd23a/652845d9aa222127cf458b43?signature=6166650f222942685e82716f09fa42cdd58f4547dcfacfa50f838b05c0e725cd)
---
| | | Together, we can make a difference for working moms in our district. Let's ensure their hard work is recognized and supported, not just on National Working Moms Day, but every day.

Thank you for your generosity and support.

Sincerely,

Carmen Goers

For many kids their most reliable meal of the day is school lunch. The summer time signifies a lack of nourishment for some children and when Republican leaders were given the chance to remedy this problem, they denied it.

We need leaders like our endorsed candidates who address issues like child hunger with compassion. We need leaders who push for policies that seek to help members of some of our most vulnerable populations — not punish them.

As the _ONLY_ PAC for kids our mission is to fight for a better future for our children. But kids can’t focus in school, thrive, or be the leaders of tomorrow if they’re suffering from hunger.

name: =?utf-8?Q?Brencia=20Berry?=
subject: The Fight for the Soul of Our Nation
body:
| | | |
---
| | | Dear Friends, President Biden and Vice President Harris are our presumptive nominees! The 2024 election is about fighting for our rights and winning. The fight for reproductive freedoms, and fighting against draconian measures that take away a woman’s right to make their own health care decisions; the fight to end the gun violence epidemic and to keep our children and our communities safe. This is going to be a fight to protect democracy and the soul of our nation – and there are only two people that can finish the job: President Biden and Vice President Harris. Below, you can find new resources to engage your community, including new multilingual fact sheets detailing the Biden-Harris administration’s commitment to all Americans, ways to join our new Students for Biden program, and news to amplify regarding the president and the vice president’s events over the weekend!
In solidarity, Brencia Berry,

DNC Political Director
---
|
---
| **Constituency Fact Sheets**
---
|
---
---
|
---
---
| It’s no secret – The Biden-Harris administration has delivered for all of our communities. From lowering costs for hardworking families to working to defend the rights of all Americans, this administration has shown its commitment to helping every American, no matter their background. **[http://joe.link/Black_Americans_Fact_Sheet](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=8a4c936e9d&e=d6c5c7d7ec)** **[https://joe.link/Latino_Americans_Fact_Sheet](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=cd5069ae1e&e=d6c5c7d7ec)** **[https://joe.link/Latino_Americans_Fact_Sheet_Spanish](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=b8237f35b7&e=d6c5c7d7ec)** **[https://joe.link/AANHPI_Fact_Sheet](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=51ee3d96b5&e=d6c5c7d7ec)**
---
|
---
| **Youth Endorsements**
---
|
---
---
| On Monday, the Biden-Harris campaign launched Students for Biden-Harris, a national organizing program to mobilize young voters across the country to reelect Joe Biden and Kamala Harris by meeting them where they are – on campuses, online, and beyond. Students for Biden-Harris will help mobilize a key part of the winning Biden-Harris coalition. As part of this launch, 15 leading youth vote and mobilization groups announced their [endorsement](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=3a394a9dbe&e=d6c5c7d7ec) of President Biden and Vice President Harris for reelection. This is the first joint and earliest endorsement from the nation’s leading youth vote groups, and builds on the broad support across the Democratic coalition for President Biden and Vice President Harris.
---
|
---
| We know when young voters show up, we win. That’s why this coalition will be working tirelessly to engage with young voters – talking to friends and families, organizing communities and campuses, registering voters, sharing content, and more – to help reelect the president and vice president. Below, please see for ways to get involved with Students for Biden-Harris:
1. Join the [Students for Biden-Harris 2024 Kick-Off with Rep. Maxwell Frost](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=da0003768b&e=d6c5c7d7ec) on Thursday, March 14 at 7:00 p.m. ET
2. Amplify the vice president’s video about the launch on social media sites including [Instagram](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=97eba02b19&e=d6c5c7d7ec), [Twitter/X](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=a7dc846fe9&e=d6c5c7d7ec), and [Facebook](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=99529865cf&e=d6c5c7d7ec)
3. Make a selfie video asking viewers to join Students for Biden-Harris – and then recruit three students to sign up as well. Anyone can join by signing up at[ JoeBiden.com/students](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=186716ba29&e=d6c5c7d7ec) or texting STUDENTS to 30330.
4. [Uplift the endorsement of President Biden and Vice President Harris from 15 leading youth vote organizations](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=5a8467491c&e=d6c5c7d7ec)

---
|
---
| **ICYMI: Historic Endorsements from Collective PAC, Latino Victory Fund, Voto Latino and AAPI Victory Fund**

---
|
---
| On Saturday, Biden-Harris 2024 received several key endorsements from groups representing the diverse coalition that sent Joe Biden and Kamala Harris to the White House in 2020. In Atlanta, alongside President Biden, the Collective PAC, Latino Victory Fund, and AAPI Victory Fund endorsed the Biden-Harris ticket and announced a historic $30 million commitment to mobilize communities of color ahead of the November election. In Las Vegas, alongside Vice President Harris, Voto Latino – the leading civic engagement organization focused on educating and empowering a new generation of Latino voters – issued its second-ever endorsement for president in the organization’s history, in support of Biden-Harris 2024. As the groups noted in their endorsements, the stakes of this election could not be higher for voters of color, and President Biden and Vice President Harris are the right candidates to fight for them. Read more about these vital endorsements in the [Washington Post](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=e9f531cb28&e=d6c5c7d7ec) and the [Las Vegas Sun](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=66b27cb9f2&e=d6c5c7d7ec).
---
|
---

DNC Community Engagement430 S Capitol Street, SEWashington, DC 20003

Want to change how you receive these emails?
You can [update your preferences](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/profile?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=acfdb5d126&e=d6c5c7d7ec&c=7ebdaf1f24) or [unsubscribe from this list](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/unsubscribe?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=acfdb5d126&t=b&e=d6c5c7d7ec&c=7ebdaf1f24).

I dove into the moment President Biden walked into the State of the Union and Trump’s appalling response to the speech. | | | Hey! I wanted to check in and make sure you saw my video earlier this week. I dove into the moment President Biden walked into the State of the Union and Trump’s appalling response to the speech. and follow my accounts at the bottom of this email for new video content. Wiley Friends – Last week, President Biden took to the stage to deliver the State of the Union Address. He gave a great speech, with a minor stutter. Donald Trump mimicked and mocked the president, setting an example that it’s ok to make fun of people who may speak a little differently than we do. I wanted to take a moment to share a story of a time I was with Joe Biden in Tennessee while working under the Obama Administration. We met a child with a stutter, and Biden went above and beyond to provide support and encouragement. President Biden is a leader we can be proud of. One who sets the example that kindness and empathy go further than bullying and mocking. Donald Trump doesn’t feel that way. He will always take low road and tear people down. As a parent, I would never want anyone to make fun of my child for their differences, and I would never want them to think it was acceptable to tear someone down. We deserve a president we can all be proud of, and that is why I am working hard this year to re-elect President Biden. VOTE RYAN MACKENZIE APRIL 23rd

Fellow American,

It is such a joy traveling around the Lehigh Valley and talking with voters. But, it is clear that people feel forgotten by the uniparty in DC and want an America First candidate to finally address their concerns. People are done with the out-of-control spending, open borders, and endless funding of foreign conflicts. I stand with them and, as my proven record shows, I always have.

Here are just a few highlights of another busy week on the campaign trail:

• ENDORSED! Portland Mayor Heather Fischer

• Portland Meet and Greet

• Northampton County Sportsmen’s Breakfast

• Lehigh County Meet and Greet

As always, if you need to get in contact with my campaign, please feel free to reach out at (484) 347-8777.

All the Best,

-Ryan Mackenzie

Endorsement from Portland Mayor Heather Fischer

I am happy to announce I’ve earned the endorsement of Portland Mayor Heather Fischer. She supports me because I am willing to go and talk to the people throughout the entirety of PA-7. Mayor Fischer said “We need people in Congress that will work with local government on the real issues at hand, and Ryan Mackenzie is that candidate”

(pictured left to right: Ryan Mackenzie, Mayor Fischer, Representative Ann Flood)

Portland Meet and Greet

No one should feel forgotten by their elected officials. Unfortunately, that’s exactly what people have experienced with Susan Wild as their representative in Congress. I heard it at our meet and greet event in Portland and I hear it everywhere I go in the 7th District.

I was grateful to stand with State Representative Ann Flood and Portland Mayor Heather Fischer to talk about how we do things differently. As a state representative in Lehigh County, I’ve always worked hard to listen to constituents, local officials, and community groups to hear their concerns and then take action on their behalf. That’s how I’ve won broad-based support in every election I’ve run in - and how we will win the 7th District in November.

Northampton County Sportsmen’s Breakfast

On Sunday I attended events all across the 7th District. One big highlight: my stop in Bath for a Sportsmen’s Breakfast. It was a great opportunity to spend time and talk issues with people who share my commitment to protecting our 2nd Amendment Rights.

Lehigh County Meet and Greet

#TeamMackenzie keeps growing and the grassroots momentum of our campaign does too! Thank you to so many local residents who showed up for our Meet-and-Greet House Party & Fundraiser. A packed house of supporters was on hand to find out how they can help us run right through the finish line on April 23rd. I hope you will join them.

#TeamMackenzie and I continue to work hard every single day as we head toward the Primary on April 23rd, and then straight to the General Election in November! It’s Women’s History Month, but this year, beyond lifting inspirational women and their achievements, I want to highlight recent inequities and threats to women’s rights.

Fundamental protections that women won in my lifetime are in peril thanks in part to the far-right contingent in Congress – a contingent that is increasingly detached from the needs of the American people. Nevertheless, with _Roe_ overturned, **we’re losing ground on our reproductive rights and bodily autonomy to a GOP determined to use its power to control women’s bodies.**

The recent ruling on IVF in Alabama, women fleeing their home states to get lifesaving care, teen girls being forced to share their reproductive history in order to play sports — such headlines underscore the dire, dangerous nature of this moment.

Truth be told, it was a serendipitous blend of several factors. Yes, I admit, the clock wasn't my ally that evening, and time's fleeting nature placed me beside MTG. The chance for an aisle seat offered by a colleague (clearly with a sense of humor) was tempting, though I didn't expect the MAGA surprise waiting there. The options were clear: stand tucked away behind the crowd for two hours or take the olive branch seat to demonstrate unity in our divided halls. With the lessons of civility instilled by my parents echoing strongly, I chose to sit, honoring their wisdom to respect others. My initial intent was to graciously ignore our differences for the evening, but the universe had other plans. I tried my very best just to ignore her, BUT I COULDN'T.
**[**Do we wish for MTG, Lauren Boebert, Josh Hawley, and Tommy Tuberville to hold the reins of Congress? Or do we rally together for the soul and future of our democracy? If your vision of the future diverges from theirs as resolutely as mine, I urge you to act!**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80901617/460748282/-112044193?refcode=0313&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS85MzczOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NGVjZGIwYS03MGUxLWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM4NDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=2Zy_GyxSnGYed7wvzhbNvajmpfj3fIk4AuimrhTfzwk=)**

body:
Here’s where you come in.
# [](https://act.hillharper.com/go/421?t=1&akid=1062%2E62735%2EsiHbHh)
**“A Biden victory in Michigan could depend on Black Voters”**
\- NPR, 3/10
Just to be clear: It _will_ depend on Black voters. Let’s do some quick math.
In 2020, we showed up at the polls and helped President Biden flip Michigan by a margin of about 154,000 votes. Trump won here in 2016 by just under 11,000 votes.
The difference? In 2016, a whopping 227,000 Black voters didn’t cast a ballot. So don’t tell me it “could” depend on Black voters — it will, Peter.
Black voters have been _the_ deciding factor in the last two elections, not just here in Michigan, but in _key_ swing states like Georgia. And what I’m hearing out on the campaign trail is that Black voters feel like they’re not getting anything for their vote, despite their loyalty at the ballot box.
Who can blame them? Establishment Democrats come running for their vote in even years and forget about them in odd years.
**Peter, I’m running a different kind of campaign. That’s why I’m counting on _your_ support to mobilize _every_ voter, win this race, and deliver Democratic victories across the ballot.**

| | Politics in New Jersey is facing a real crossroads right now between elite control and the power of people. The same leaders who gain political control through machine politics are getting ready to ram through a bill gutting OPRA and transparency. These problems are interconnected. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80902661/460752137/-1197072038?refcode=2024-03-13-opra&recurring=&amount=3&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=97bb3793-73e1-ee11-85f9-002248223848&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzk3MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5N2JiMzc5My03M2UxLWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM4NDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=WbCzJaBn71Veo9Pnm7oqfeKjInZuMVoGpr_ILhbG26Y=) If you don't know, OPRA is the way that regular people can access government records in New Jersey. It's an important way to hold people in power accountable and to let you know what's going on. It's why I was very disturbed to hear that politicians in New Jersey were working to weaken this incredibly critical tool. We have so many real issues to deal with - affordability, climate change, gun safety - for these politicians to fast-track a bill gutting transparency is simply unacceptable. Even more so, when a State Senator on the committee said he'd planned to vote against the bill, the political leadership removed him from his committee to silence him. It just shows that the only thing that matters is the power of the political elite, not the public servants who are here to represent us. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/80902662/460752138/-1197072038?refcode=2024-03-13-opra&recurring=&amount=3&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=97bb3793-73e1-ee11-85f9-002248223848&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzk3MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5N2JiMzc5My03M2UxLWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM4NDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=WbCzJaBn71Veo9Pnm7oqfeKjInZuMVoGpr_ILhbG26Y=) In a lot of ways, gutting transparency laws is just like the broken machine politics we've seen dominating this election. When decisions are made behind closed doors by the political elite, it sends a signal loud and clear that what regular people think does not matter. It takes away the power of people like us who deserve the right to know what our public servants are doing and know that they're working for us. Look, I know this because I've been a public servant my entire career. As a former federal government employee, knowing our work and our docs were subject to public record transparency laws also shaped behavior. It created a more professional work environment that tried to minimize abuses of power and wrongdoings. It doesn't always work, but that understanding of transparency hangs over everyone and affects decision-making and actions. To reduce transparency sends a further signal to lawmakers and government employees that they work more for political elites than the people. **New Jersey politics has been broken for a long time, but there has never been as much of a spotlight shining on these problems as there is now. It means we can make a change.** Political elites are hoping this attention will die down. Let us be persistent and resilient in our push for change. Fellow American,

I want to introduce myself.

My name is Nella Domenici – I’m a proud New Mexican, devoted mother, wife of a Navy veteran, businesswoman, and I’m excited to announce to you that **I am running to be the next Republican U.S. Senator from New Mexico.**

**It’s not breaking news for me to say our nation and state are clearly on the wrong track.**

To say that Joe Biden and my opponent Martin Heinrich’s policies have failed us seems inadequate – _it’s like they don’t even understand us._

**The cost of living is way up, the border is wide open, our crime and drug crises are out of control, and our public education system is leaving our kids behind.**

Team, it’s Greg. **I just wanted to take a quick moment and wish everyone a happy Women’s History Month!**

Every year, Women’s History Month serves as an opportunity to reflect on how far our country has come in the fight for gender equality and reproductive freedom — _and as a reminder of how much work we have left to do._

It’s no secret that extremist Republicans and their allies on the Supreme Court are trying to turn back the clock on all the progress we’ve made over the past few decades.

But if we stand together and fight for a better, more inclusive future — _one that leaves no one behind_ — I know we can defend our progress and ensure reproductive freedom for everyone in this country.

**That’s ultimately what’s at stake in this election.**

From defending the right to bodily autonomy, to pushing for equal pay, to increasing access to affordable childcare for working mothers — our work to create an equal and just society is nowhere near finished.

**But I’m proud to have you by my side in the fight ahead — and together, I know we can get the job done. Happy Women’s History Month!**

In solidarity,

_Greg Landsman_

| | **WEEKLY UPDATE FROM REP. RYAN CHAMBERLIN**
---
| My fellow Floridians,

At the end of last week, we wrapped up the 2024 Legislative Session, and I am now back home in the district with my family. I am so proud of what my colleagues and I accomplished during our time in Tallahassee! As State Representative for House District 24, I fought hard for conservatism and worked diligently to carry the issues important to you. Serving in the Florida House has been the honor of a lifetime, and I want the district to know that I am just getting started.

Thank you for taking the time each week to read my newsletter. Your continued trust and support mean a great deal to me! I look forward to keeping you updated on my work and activity in the community in the months to come.
---
| | **Legislative Session Recap**
---
|
---
| It was an incredible honor to serve alongside so many strong leaders in the Florida House. Each of my colleagues brings unique insight to our legislative body, and I am so thankful for all the good work they do for our state and their individual communities. I look forward to joining them again in Tallahassee for the next legislative session!
---
|
---
|
---
---
| Over his two years as Speaker of the Florida House, Paul Renner oversaw historical legislation that will better the lives of future generations of Floridians. It was a privilege to serve under his leadership. He led the Florida House with strength and determination second to none, and it was an honor to support his legislative priorities for our state. He will be missed in the Florida Legislature, but I look forward to all that we will accomplish for the Sunshine State in the legislative sessions to come.
---
|
---
| Since my election, it has been an honor to work closely alongside Reps. Stan McClain, Ralph Massullo, and Bobby Payne to advocate for the needs of Marion County. Sadly, these great leaders have concluded their time in the Florida House and are now pursuing new opportunities to serve Florida. Their leadership has left a lasting impact on our state, and I look forward to carrying on their good work. I wish them all the best in their future endeavors!
---
|
---
---
| As we wrapped up in Tallahassee, I had the opportunity to meet some of our state’s law enforcement officers and their K-9 companions. Since day one, I have been a strong supporter of Florida’s law enforcement and first responders. And during this year’s legislative session, it was a privilege to sponsor a bill that supports more of these brave men and women. Read more about this legislation [here](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=878d060de3&e=d1c1b9864f)!
---
|
---
| It was wonderful to get to know Victoria, the messenger I sponsored for this legislative session. She was a great help to me on the House Floor, and I appreciated all her good work. She has a bright future ahead!
---
| | **Upcoming Events in House District 24**
---
| Over the next few weeks, I will be speaking at several events in the district. Below are some of the places where I will have the opportunity to discuss my work with the community.
* Ocala Tea Party Action’s “America First Rally”
* Stone Creek
* Oak Run
* Spruce Creek Preserve

Please keep an eye out for additional events and updates!
---
|
---
| | It has been an honor to represent District 24 in Tallahassee! The 2024 Legislative Session was one for the books, and I am incredibly grateful for the opportunity to serve my community. As always, if I may be of any assistance, please do not hesitate to contact my office by **[clicking here](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=077e35df72&e=d1c1b9864f "https://www.myfloridahouse.gov/Sections/Representatives/contactmember.aspx?MemberId=4901&SessionId=103&utm_source=Ryan+Chamberlin+for+State+Representative&utm_campaign=ae0a433299-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_12_08_05_14_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-7ddd94a0de-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D")**.

Have a great week!

Best regards,

**Ryan Chamberlin**
******State Representative**
**District 24**
---

| | Peter, As Angela’s Organizing Director, I get asked a lot — how are we going to win this race? We all know our opponent is self-funding his campaign and spending millions to try and buy this election. But we have a secret weapon — you. **That’s right, Peter, we know that YOU are the best spokesperson for your friends and family.** People are sick and tired of politicians and tv ads. Trust in institutions is at an all-time low. But people trust their friends, family members, and neighbors. That’s why we are building an organizing program that’s centered on friend-to-friend outreach! **I’m a numbers guy, and the numbers show that when people get a text from their friends or family, they are 8.3% more likely to vote!** By comparison, a text message from a stranger only has a 0.29% impact on turnout. A TV ad? Not even 4%! The #1 thing you can do to support the campaign is to reach out to your friends and family! This is hands down the best way to spread the word about the campaign. **[That is why we are asking our super supporters to bring their communities together and host an organizing house party!](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/14039?t=7&akid=1214%2E52803%2EKf31YV)** Hosting an organizing house party is simple! First, **[sign up to host an organizing house party HERE.](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/14039?t=8&akid=1214%2E52803%2EKf31YV)** Next, an organizer will be in touch to help you plan and support your event. Third, invite your friends and family over to learn about the campaign. And then we’ll train your team and we’ll help you reach out to your community! If we want to reach voters all across Maryland, we need supporters to step up and start organizing their communities because **you are the best spokespeople for our campaign!** Are you in? Team, **Today I filed paperwork with the Department of Elections to officially qualify for the September ballot! ** It’s been an honor to represent my neighbors in the State Senate, and I’m proud to have your support as we take the fight for better health care, public schools, infrastructure, worker protections, the environment, and so much more to Congress. **[If you’re ready to help us hit the ground running, will you pitch in $5 today to help us meet our first $10,000 goal since getting on the ballot? That means expanding access to **health care** , bringing costs down, and ensuring everyone can get the **reproductive care** they need. It means building an economy that benefits **workers and families** , and strengthening the rights of workers and unions. It means rescuing our **climate** , promoting sustainability, keeping our families safe from **gun violence** , and **reforming** our criminal justice system. I’ve played a key role in passing bold legislation on everything from health care to paid family and medical leave in the State Senate, and I’ve done it by bringing people together. I know that with your support, I can deliver results from Washington, too. But I’m going to need your help along the way. Election Day is just 6 months away, and while that may seem like plenty of time, we have a lot of work to do to get our message in front of Delaware voters before the polls open in September. We need to prepare early to run a winning campaign, and a big part of that preparation is meeting our grassroots fundraising goals. **To celebrate qualifying for the ballot, my team has set a goal of raising $10,000 in the next 24 hours. That means expanding access to health care , bringing costs down, and ensuring everyone can get the reproductive care they need. It means building an economy that benefits workers and families , and strengthening the rights of workers and unions. It means rescuing our climate , promoting sustainability, keeping our families safe from gun violence , and reforming our criminal justice system. I’ve played a key role in passing bold legislation on everything from health care to paid family and medical leave in the State Senate, and I’ve done it by bringing people together. I know that with your support, I can deliver results from Washington, too. But I’m going to need your help along the way. Election Day is just 6 months away, and while that may seem like plenty of time, we have a lot of work to do to get our message in front of Delaware voters before the polls open in September. We need to prepare early to run a winning campaign, and a big part of that preparation is meeting our grassroots fundraising goals. To celebrate qualifying for the ballot, my team has set a goal of raising $10,000 in the next 24 hours. = | = Thank you again for your support, team. I’ll be in touch with more updates soon! Geoff Simpson

| | Friend, In celebration of Women's History Month, it's a time to honor the countless ways women have shaped our nation and filled us with pride—whether through their monumental achievements in diverse professional fields or their invaluable contributions to our communities and families. Let's be honest, where would we be without them? I’ve been surrounded by strong, successful women my whole life. My commitment to working hard came from my mother, Joyce Burchett. She served our country and learned to fly an airplane in support of the war effort, an uncommon feat for a woman in the 1940s. She then went on to raise a family and serve her community as an educator, one of the highest callings I can think of. I’ll admit that I was an unrepentant momma’s boy, and I miss her every day. But God was smiling down on me when he blessed me with two other lovely ladies: my wife, Kelly and our daughter, Isabel. I can’t say enough about how much I truly adore these two. Kelly is my rock, especially when things get crazy here in Washington, and Isabel is the apple of our eyes. Smart as a whip and the most talented cowgirl in America, I’m amazed by her every single day. But here’s what grinds my gears, folks. Isabel isn’t growing up in a world where her accomplishments are applauded. Instead, celebrities and other people of so-called “influence” are putting [men who pretend they’re women on a pedestal](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=79768d0694a9437db237fd15661fdc01&_e=3QRlLHdGrU3XJCUU4eBMCvccMGAXmiUv9Wz2vMwbIhL9E_plaCnCwr1xfkX306fYnp4dWuXiYuJID98woinAr76glL6k4XQMrhNfIIwH1cI0shBslnlu2j1lE2-rgyeoUGx8GlRMwYMju1G9J1HI6O-y7cVK7nUakZSwT7D2MM27Y5drPfWRzyjzRUOD9aTFMdlCewtNxat74cMmgknqsB1yGF09UJga8_MdaU1U_EKnrkT4llgw_0fPcEqOgtKTCRbrpa3uB9XtInQ8CyL9zNBy1IyPi5HFrriX_oZtfK6lJtqRJw1SoHsotFIaQAiR). They demand that we celebrate games of dress-up and ignore the phenomenal strides biological women are making every day. **[**> >> I refuse to fake admiration or respect for biological men who are trying to steal the God-given femininity only real women can claim. Are you with me? body:
The Biden Administration Needs To Be Held Accountable |
---
| | [ ](https://juanciscomani.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4ed32a393c9fe1089f10fee94&id=ba4c2eebb6&e=659fba240e)
---
| | Hey friend, Juan here,

Every day, we live with the reality of an unsecured border.

The challenges we face are not just headlines in the news; they are the lived experiences of our communities. Some proposals have merely been a band-aid on a gaping wound — none are lasting solutions.

Even worse, the Biden administration's “strategy” of prioritizing comfort over security, sends a dangerous message that our borders are open for all.**This is not the path to security or sovereignty. **

Under President Biden's watch, we've witnessed an unprecedented surge in illegal crossings, jeopardizing our communities, overwhelming our border patrol, and undermining the rule of law. The administration's policies have effectively rolled out the welcome mat for illegal immigration, with disastrous consequences for national security and public safety.

**We need decisive action, not tepid responses. **

Real change is possible. With straightforward actions like ending catch and release and reinstating the Remain in Mexico policy, we can take back control. These aren't radical ideas; they're common-sense solutions that have been dismantled and caused our current crisis.

That’s why I supported the Laken Riley Act – a crucial piece of legislation that will require ICE to detain illegal immigrants charged with theft or burglary. Laken Riley was a nursing student at the University of Georgia whose life was taken too soon by an illegal immigrant. Tragedies like these are a result of poor leadership from the Biden administration.

Additionally, my recent bill to combat high-speed car chases — _which has already passed the House_ — is another example of targeted legislation that addresses specific issues head-on.

**But I need your support.** **Here’s how you can help:**
* **[Sign My Petition](https://juanciscomani.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4ed32a393c9fe1089f10fee94&id=13363e1335&e=659fba240e):** Help me get on the ballot to send a message to Congress that you demand robust border security measures to protect our communities and uphold the rule of law.
* **[Donate](https://juanciscomani.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4ed32a393c9fe1089f10fee94&id=6f22744c64&e=659fba240e):** Your contributions enable us to continue fighting for effective border solutions that prioritize the safety and security of Americans.
* **Stay Informed:** Follow us on social media for updates on our efforts to secure the border.

Our border policy must be more than a political talking point; it needs to be a**real plan** that ensures the safety and security of Arizonans and all Americans. Together, we can achieve real solutions and restore order to our southern border. Thank you for standing with us in this fight. With gratitude, Juan Ciscomani _P.S. Our community deserves better than half-measures. Join me in pushing for the lasting solutions Southern Arizona needs. _

As state lawmakers continue to introduce anti-abortion legislation and work to strip away the freedom of choice in the wake of the _Dobbs v. Jackson_ Supreme Court decision, this season of _Civics for the Culture_ provides key insights into how we ended up here and why reproductive rights is one of the most defining issues of our time. ---
[](http://email.email.freethinkerdaily.com/c/eJw8jj1vszAUhX-N2Yx873UMHjy8byM6deiQrJU_LsEqBASOWv59RVR1PefROY-fljH3uxPNf4E45LQJREH_BOKj0NVfLm_rLuk9yNfTFW9HiS8CsewL_5G_IzVPPo9H2pyr5DR66GPFDhpQZCwoqgbXtCYRawsKW2shWQt9DMH31Lbam1Blhwq1IiBEAjK1hh48KAXsLTAYodXzqO5X5jLk-yevyedxr-M8VaMbSlm2p1gnsNs4Plau_Z3TXA5CYHePSxLYpSALJsmTPKHk7yKo2-bHGvkjzokFnVOQByp5OmGQCky1urR85XHMm2mEVrenR5ynnwAAAP__Gsph0g)
---
From the bottom of my heart, I'm asking you to take a moment to consider Officer Chris Taylor's plight and his young family. _This isn't just a request; it's a plea for justice, understanding, and compassion._ Officer Chris Taylor stands on the brink of losing everything—his freedom, his family, his future—all for doing the job he swore an oath to do: protect and serve. **[I’m reaching out to you to ask for your financial support towards Chris’s defense. Will you donate $20, $50, $100 or more to help this brave officer cover massive and unjust legal bills?](http://email.email.freethinkerdaily.com/c/eJw8jj1vszAUhX-N2Yx873UMHjy8byM6deiQrJU_LsEqBASOWv59RVR1PefROY-fljH3uxPNf4E45LQJREH_BOKj0NVfLm_rLuk9yNfTFW9HiS8CsewL_5G_IzVPPo9H2pyr5DR66GPFDhpQZCwoqgbXtCYRawsKW2shWQt9DMH31Lbam1Blhwq1IiBEAjK1hh48KAXsLTAYodXzqO5X5jLk-yevyedxr-M8VaMbSlm2p1gnsNs4Plau_Z3TXA5CYHePSxLYpSALJsmTPKHk7yKo2-bHGvkjzokFnVOQByp5OmGQCky1urR85XHMm2mEVrenR5ynnwAAAP__Gsph0g)** Chris faces a trial that could unjustly imprison him for life. The charge? Acting in defense of himself and others against an imminent, life-threatening danger. He simply followed his training to protect the residents of an apartment building from the knife-wielding suspect menacing them before he could stab Chris and his fellow officers. Yet, despite his actions being in line with his duty, he's been ensnared by a legal system that seems more interested in making examples out of our officers than in serving justice. The heart of this ordeal is a confrontation that turned perilous instantly—a scenario officers dread but are prepared for. Chris did what he was trained to do. But now, an indictment looms over him, propelled by a District Attorney whose campaign was bankrolled by George Soros. This isn't just an attack on Chris; it's an assault on the very principles of law and order. The toll this has taken on Chris's family is unimaginable. Amy, his wife, and their son now face a future shrouded in uncertainty, potentially without Chris by their side. It's a scenario no family should ever have to contemplate, much less endure. Our system, designed to protect the guardians of our safety, is failing. That's why I'm stepping forward, not just as a sheriff but as a citizen deeply concerned about the precedent Chris's case could set. # [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1226%2E135344%2Et2v5tz)

No one person can win a race for U.S. Senate by themselves.
There are some things I can do -- like make sure I am campaigning hard and talking to voters every single day.
But there are a lot of things I can’t do on my own – which is why we’re building a grassroots team of volunteers who are knocking doors, making calls, and talking to voters as early as possible.
Here is a photo from our first “Snow Boots on the Ground” of 2024 from earlier this month. We’ve done similar events rain, snow, or shine in every one of my campaigns since 2018 because I believe a ground game -- knocking doors, making calls, sending texts, and registering voters -- is critical to win in our very swingy swing state. The goal is to train up volunteers to make sure they have what they need to talk to voters early.
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-mar24.YRUw2h&refcode=em240313-2-15&t=2&akid=1226%2E135344%2Et2v5tz)
But there’s another thing I can’t do myself, and that’s fund a winning campaign with personal resources. While some of our opponents can write themselves big checks, our campaign is relying on a whole lot of people chipping in a little at a time.
If we're going to keep this Senate seat blue, and if we're going to make sure Joe Biden wins Michigan (and the White House), it will take all of us.
Our average online donation is around $40.
Some give more, some give less. All that matters is that you're chipping in what you can to help us meet the fundraising goals we need to reach in order to win.

subject: The gun lobby’s glory days are behind them

body:
I noticed a familiar face in a recent issue of American Rifleman . (Yes, I really read it. You’ve got to keep your friends close and enemies closer, after all.)
To no one’s surprise, the NRA took out a full-page ad bashing me — and by extension, all of the folks who are a part of this movement to reform our gun laws, make progressive change, and elect the next generation of bold, young leaders.
The ads in these magazines are always good for a laugh — but this kind of stuff also reminds me how scared of us they really are. I’ve said it before, but Gen Z will most certainly outlive the NRA . The gun lobby’s glory days are behind them now.
